Curative therapy was delayed because the patient ignored early warning signs. 由于患者忽视早期警示信号，有效治疗被延误。

defs.cn: 拳曲的, 卷毛的, 弯曲的

words.root: curl卷曲+y→卷曲的
exs: The curly lock fell across her forehead during the exam. 卷发在考试时垂到她额前。
He brushed the curly hair that kept escaping from the ribbon. 他梳理那缕总从发带里逃出来的卷发。

defs.cn: 货币, 通货, 流通, 通用；[计] 货币, 货币型

words.root: curr跑+ency→流通的钱→货币。
exs: The euro remains a stable currency in Europe. 欧元在欧洲仍是稳定货币。
A currency that fluctuates wildly can damage trade confidence. 剧烈波动的货币可能损害贸易信心。

defs.cn: 现在, 当前, 一般, 普通；[计] 当前

words.root: current当前+ly→当前地。
exs: The company is currently testing a new app for local farmers. 该公司正在为当地农民测试一款新应用。
Currently working from home, many employees feel isolated despite daily meetings. 目前在家办公的许多员工尽管每日开会仍感到孤立。

defs.cn: 课程；[医] 课程, 学程

words.root: curr（跑）→ 学习进程 → 课程
exs: The university revised its core curriculum to include data science and ethics. 大学修订了核心课程，纳入数据科学与伦理。
Hoping to meet industry demands, faculty members redesigned the curriculum within six months. 为满足行业需求，教师在六个月内重新设计了课程。

defs.cn: 简略的, 简短的, 生硬的

words.root: 拉丁curtus（短）→话被砍短→简略生硬
exs: The manager gave a curt reply and turned away without explanation. 经理简短生硬地回答，随即转身离开，没有解释。
Curt in tone, the receptionist refused to answer our repeated questions. 语气生硬，前台拒绝回答我们反复提出的问题。

defs.cn: 习惯的, 惯常的；[经] 通常的, 习惯的

words.root: custom(习俗)+-ary(形容词)→习惯的
exs: Many employees consider overtime customary during the company's busy season. 许多员工认为公司旺季加班是惯例。
Although imported goods are common, handmade gifts remain customary. 虽然进口商品常见，但手工礼物仍是惯例。

defs.cn: 裁剪者, 切割者, 切割器；[化] 刀具; 剪切机; 切刀; 切胶机

words.root: cut（切）+ -er（人/物）→ 切割者
exs: The skilled cutter trimmed the leather pieces with steady hands. 熟练的切割工用稳定的手修剪皮革片。
Using a laser cutter, the factory reduces waste while meeting tight deadlines. 使用激光切割器，工厂在满足紧迫工期的同时减少浪费。

defs.cn: 圆筒, 圆筒状物, 汽缸, 柱面；[计] 柱面

words.root: 希腊kylindein滚动→可滚圆筒→汽缸
exs: The cracked cylinder caused the engine to fail unexpectedly. 裂开的汽缸导致发动机意外故障。
A polished steel cylinder, measuring two meters long, stood in the museum. 一根两米长的抛光钢制圆筒立在博物馆里。

defs.cn: 愤世嫉俗的, 讽刺的, 冷嘲的

words.root: cynic(愤世者)+-al→愤世嫉俗的
exs: His cynical remarks made the young intern feel unwelcome. 他愤世嫉俗的言论让年轻实习生感到不受欢迎。
The reporter grew cynical after covering repeated corporate scandals. 报道多次企业丑闻后，这位记者变得愤世嫉俗。

defs.cn: 一点, 诅咒, 丝毫；interj. 该死, 该死的
指责, 谴责, 骂...该死, 证明...有罪

words.root: damn（定罪/损害）→ 诅咒/该死
exs: He did not give a damn about the criticism. 他根本不在乎那些批评。
Damn the contract, which promised quick payment but caused endless disputes. 诅咒这份合同，它承诺快速付款却引发了无尽纠纷。

defs.cn: 论据, 材料, 资料, 已知数；[医] 材料, 资料, 论据

words.root: 拉丁dare给→给出的材料→论据；复数data
exs: One datum proved insufficient to support his controversial historical claim. 一项论据不足以支持他那有争议的历史观点。
Having checked each datum, the researchers revised the statistical model. 核对每项资料后，研究人员修正了统计模型。

words.root: 钻石闪耀，晃得眼花
exs: The diamond necklace dazzled the guests at the charity gala. 钻石项链在慈善晚会上令宾客目眩。
Dazzled by stage lights, the singer forgot her opening lines. 被舞台灯光晃得眼花，歌手忘了开场词。

words.root: deaf（聋）+ -en（使）→ 使聋
exs: The sudden explosion deafened several workers in the factory. 突然的爆炸使工厂里的几名工人失聪。
Deafened by the roar, the dog ran behind the sofa for safety. 被吼声震聋后，狗跑到沙发后面寻求安全。

defs.cn: 经销商, 商人；[经] 交易员, 贩卖商

words.root: deal交易+er人→做交易的人→经销商
exs: The authorized dealer offered a discount on the imported equipment. 授权经销商对进口设备提供了折扣。
A drug dealer was arrested after police tracked his shipments. 警方追踪其货运后，一名毒贩被捕。

defs.cn: 院长, 主持牧师；[法] 外交团长, 学院院长, 教务长

words.root: dean原指十人长→院长
exs: The dean announced a new scholarship for first-generation college students. 院长宣布了一项面向第一代大学生的新奖学金。
The dean, who oversees admissions, postponed the policy decision. 负责招生的院长推迟了该政策决定。

defs.cn: 迷惑的, 虚伪的, 欺诈的

words.root: deceive（骗）+ -ive → 欺骗性的
exs: The advertisement contained deceptive claims about the product's lifespan. 广告中包含关于产品寿命的欺骗性宣传。
Seemingly harmless, the deceptive email asked users to update their passwords. 看似无害的欺诈邮件要求用户更新密码。

defs.cn: 决定了, 坚决, 明显, 显而易见, 显然, 明确, 果断, 毫无疑问

words.root: de-加强+cide切/决定+ly→切得果断→坚决
exs: She spoke decidedly about the need for stricter environmental rules. 她坚决谈到需要更严格的环境规则。
Decidedly more expensive, the new laptop still impressed most buyers. 新笔记本电脑明显更贵，但仍打动多数买家。

defs.cn: 十进制, 小数；[计] 十进制, 小数点

words.root: decem(十)+-al→十进制/小数
exs: The price tag shows exact costs with decimal numbers. 价签用小数显示精确成本。
Because computers store decimal values approximately, rounding errors may occur. 因为计算机近似存储小数值，舍入误差可能出现。

defs.cn: 决定性的, 坚定的, 果断的

words.root: decide（决定）+ -ive → 决定性的
exs: The captain made a decisive call during the final quarter. 队长在最后时刻做出了果断决定。
A decisive victory, which lifted morale across the region, followed months of planning. 一场提振全地区士气的决定性胜利，在数月筹备后到来。

defs.cn: 宣告, 说明, 宣布；[计] 说明

words.root: de-加强+clar清楚+ation→说清楚→宣告
exs: The declaration announced a new policy on renewable energy. 该声明宣布了可再生能源新政策。
Having signed the declaration, ministers pledged to reduce carbon emissions. 签署声明后，部长们承诺减少碳排放。

words.root: de-(离开)+compose(组成)→分解
exs: In warm soil, bacteria decompose dead plants into nutrient-rich material. 在温暖土壤中，细菌将死植物分解为富含养分物质。
Chemical agents decompose pollutants before wastewater enters the river. 化学制剂在废水进入河流前分解污染物。

words.root: de+decor(装饰)+ative→装饰性
exs: The ceramic tiles are decorative rather than structural. 这些陶瓷瓷砖是装饰性的，而非结构性的。
The museum added decorative patterns, enhancing the hall's visual appeal. 博物馆添加了装饰图案，增强了大厅的视觉吸引力。

defs.cn: 法令, 判决, 天意

words.root: de-（分开）+ cern（分辨）→ 裁定 → 法令
exs: The government announced a new decree in parliament yesterday. 政府昨天在议会宣布了一项新法令。
The decree that the ministry issued last week requires factories to report waste daily. 该部门上周颁布的法令要求工厂每日报告废弃物。

words.root: de-（加强）+ dic（宣告）→ 献出
exs: Many teachers dedicate their lives to rural education. 许多教师把一生奉献给乡村教育。
Having moved to the village, she dedicated her weekends to teaching children. 搬到村里后，她把周末都用来教孩子们。

defs.cn: 扣除, 减去；[经] 扣除, 减去, 折扣

words.root: de+duct(引导)→引走→扣除
exs: Please deduct ten percent from the total invoice amount. 请从发票总金额中扣除百分之十。
If you deduct the deposit, the customer may complain. 如果你扣除押金，顾客可能会投诉。

words.root: 与doom同源：判定/宣判→认为
exs: Most experts deem the new regulation too strict for small businesses. 多数专家认为新规对小企业过于严格。
Deemed essential by the committee, the proposal will be implemented next quarter. 被委员会视为必要后，该提案将于下季度实施。

defs.cn: 违约, 不履行责任, 缺席, 默认值
疏怠职责, 缺席, 拖欠, 默认；[计] 默认; 默认值; 缺省值

words.root: de-（离开）+ fault（过失）→ 不履行 → 默认
exs: The borrower defaulted on his loan last month. 借款人上个月拖欠贷款。
If the user changes nothing, the browser uses the default settings. 如果用户不作修改，浏览器会使用默认设置。

words.root: de+fend(打击)+ant→被告
exs: The defendant denied all charges during the preliminary hearing. 被告在初步听证会上否认了所有指控。
The defendant, fearing a harsh sentence, hired an experienced lawyer. 被告担心严厉判决，聘请了经验丰富的律师。

defs.cn: 恭敬的；[医] 输精管的

words.root: de-（向下）+ fer（带）→ 让位→恭敬
exs: The junior clerk spoke in a deferential tone before the senior judge. 初级职员在资深法官面前用恭敬的语气说话。
He treated the retired professor deferentially, as though every word carried authority. 他对退休教授十分恭敬，仿佛每句话都带着权威。

defs.cn: 缺乏, 不足；[医] 缺乏, 不足

words.root: de-（向下）+ fici（做）→ 不足 → 缺乏
exs: A vitamin D deficiency can weaken bones over time. 维生素D缺乏会随时间削弱骨骼。
The doctor diagnosed anemia caused by an iron deficiency. 医生诊断出由缺铁引起的贫血。

defs.cn: 不足的, 不充分的, 有缺陷的

words.root: de+fic(做)+ient→不足
exs: The research report is deficient in statistical evidence. 该研究报告缺乏统计证据。
Students who are deficient in grammar often struggle in writing. 语法薄弱的学生在写作中常常吃力。

defs.cn: 赤字, 不足额；[医] 短缺

words.root: de-（离开）+ fic（做）→ 没做到→不足
exs: The city council faced a serious deficit after the flood repair costs. 洪水修复费用后，市议会面临严重赤字。
To reduce the annual deficit, the ministry raised taxes on luxury goods. 为减少年度赤字，该部门提高了奢侈品税。

words.root: de-（离开）+ flect（弯）→ 使弯离 → 偏斜
exs: The helmet deflected a falling branch during the storm. 头盔在暴风雨中偏开了一根掉落的树枝。
To protect the bridge, engineers designed barriers that deflect strong winds. 为了保护桥梁，工程师设计了能偏转强风的屏障。

defs.cn: 歪斜, 偏, 偏向；[医] 偏向, 偏离, 偏转(光), 偏转, 波(心电图)

words.root: de+flect(弯)+ion→偏转
exs: The engineer measured the deflection of the steel beam. 工程师测量了钢梁的偏转。
The light's deflection, caused by the prism, surprised the students. 棱镜造成的光线偏转让学生惊讶。

words.root: de-（破坏）+ form（形状）→ 变形
exs: Extreme heat can deform the plastic casing of the battery. 极端高温会使电池塑料外壳变形。
The metal beam deformed after the earthquake damaged its supporting joints. 地震损坏支撑节点后，金属梁发生了变形。

defs.cn: 损形, 变丑, 畸形；[化] 变形; 形变

words.root: de-（离开）+ form（形）→ 形状走样 → 变形
exs: The metal deformation appeared after the car accident. 车祸后金属出现变形。
Heat caused the plastic deformation, making the handle unusable. 高温导致塑料变形，使手柄无法使用。

defs.cn: 藐视, 挑衅, 使落空

words.root: de-（背离）+ fy（=fid 信任）→ 不信任 → 违抗
exs: The protesters continued to defy the government ban despite the warnings. 尽管有警告，抗议者仍继续违抗政府的禁令。
Her calm smile seemed to defy explanation. 她平静的微笑似乎难以解释。

words.root: de-（向下）+ gener（产生）→ 向下退化→堕落
exs: The once vibrant neighbourhood has become a degenerate slum. 这个曾经充满活力的街区已沦为堕落贫民窟。
If the government fails to act, public trust will degenerate into cynicism. 如果政府不作为，公众信任将退化为犬儒主义。

defs.cn: 降格, 堕落, 退化；[计] 降级

words.root: de-（向下）+ grad（级）→ 降格 → 退化
exs: The old painting suffered severe degradation from humidity. 这幅旧画因潮湿严重退化。
Repeated exposure to sunlight caused the degradation of the fabric, leaving it brittle. 反复日晒导致织物退化，使其变脆。

words.root: de-（向下）+ grade（等级）→ 降级/退化
exs: Air pollution can degrade the quality of soil in rural areas. 空气污染会降低农村地区土壤的质量。
Degrading gradually, the soil lost its fertility after years of intensive farming. 土壤逐渐退化，在多年集约耕作后失去了肥力。

defs.cn: 细软, 精致, 精美的食品, 娇气, 微妙, 棘手, 娇弱, 灵敏, 灵巧

words.root: delic（精致）+ -acy（名词）→ 精致、美味
exs: The chef's signature delicacy impressed every guest at the banquet. 厨师的招牌美味给宴会上的每位客人留下了深刻印象。
Serving such a rare delicacy requires patience, because its preparation is delicate. 供应这样罕见的佳肴需要耐心，因为它的制作很精细。

defs.cn: 迷惑, 欺瞒, 错觉；[医] 妄想

words.root: de-（离开）+ lus（玩）→ 被玩弄→错觉
exs: He suffered from a dangerous delusion about his own medical condition. 他对自己的健康状况有一种危险的妄想。
Believing her own delusion, she refused treatment until her family persuaded her. 她相信自己的妄想，拒绝治疗，直到家人说服她。

defs.cn: 人口统计学；[医] 人口学, 人口统计学

words.root: demo（人民）+ graphy（学科）→ 人口学
exs: Demography helps governments plan schools, hospitals, and social services. 人口统计学帮助政府规划学校、医院和社会服务。
Studying demography, she found that the aging population is increasing rapidly. 学习人口统计学时，她发现老龄人口正迅速增加。

defs.cn: 否认；[法] 否定, 否认, 拒绝接受

words.root: de-（完全）+ neg（否定）→ 否认
exs: His calm denial surprised the reporters outside the courthouse. 他平静的否认让法院外的记者感到意外。
After denying the rumor, she issued a written denial to protect her reputation. 在否认谣言后，她发布了书面否认以保护自己的声誉。

words.root: de-（加强）+ note（标记）→ 标示
exs: The red flag denotes a serious violation of environmental regulations here. 这面红旗表示此处严重违反环保法规。
A symbol can denote an idea that many readers may not share. 一个符号可以表示许多读者未必认同的概念。

defs.cn: 告发, 抨击, 谴责；[法] 谴责, 斥责, 告发

words.root: de-（加强）+ nounce（说）→ 公开谴责
exs: The council denounced the factory for polluting the local river. 委员会谴责该工厂污染当地河流。
He denounced the policy, claiming that it would harm small farmers. 他谴责该政策，声称它会损害小农户的利益。

defs.cn: 牙科医生；[医] 牙医师

words.root: dens/dent（牙）+ -ist（人）→ 牙医
exs: The dentist cleaned my teeth and gave useful advice. 牙医给我清洁了牙齿并给出了有用的建议。
When I feared pain, the dentist explained the procedure calmly. 当我担心疼痛时，牙医平静地解释了治疗过程。

defs.cn: 家眷, 侍从, 食客；[法] 受赡养人, 家庭负担

words.root: de-（向下）+ pend（挂）→ 挂靠→受赡养人
exs: The old man supported three dependants with his small pension. 这位老人靠微薄的养老金供养三个受赡养人。
Having registered as a dependant, she could receive medical care. 登记成为受赡养人后，她可以获得医疗服务。

words.root: de-（加强）+ pict（画）→ 描绘
exs: The painting depicts villagers harvesting rice under a golden sky. 这幅画描绘了村民在金色天空下收割稻谷。
Depicting the disaster honestly, the reporter won public trust. 记者如实描绘灾难，赢得了公众信任。

words.root: dis-（分开）+ ploy（折叠）→ 展开、部署
exs: The commander deployed troops along the northern border. 指挥官在北部边境部署了部队。
After deploying additional resources, the company reduced delivery delays significantly. 在调配额外资源后，公司显著减少了配送延误。

defs.cn: 驱逐出境, 放逐；[法] 递解出境, 放逐, 驱逐

words.root: de-（离开）+ port（搬运）→ 搬离→驱逐出境
exs: The government announced the deportation of several undocumented workers yesterday. 政府昨天宣布驱逐数名无证工人。
Facing deportation, the student hired a lawyer to challenge the order. 面临驱逐出境，该学生聘请律师挑战这项命令。

defs.cn: 免职, 作证, 沉淀；[化] 沉积

words.root: de-（向下）+ posit（放）→ 沉淀/免职/作证
exs: The deposition of sediment blocked the harbor entrance for months. 沉积物堆积使港口入口堵塞了数月。
Having given a deposition, the witness left the courtroom quietly. 完成作证后，证人安静地离开了法庭。

defs.cn: 推论, 推导, 来历；[医] 衍化, 诱导

words.root: de-（向下）+ riv（河流）→ 来源、推导
exs: The derivation of the formula surprised even the professor. 这个公式的推导令教授都感到惊讶。
By tracing its derivation, students understood how the word evolved. 通过追溯其来源，学生们理解了这个词是如何演变的。

words.root: de-（向下）+ scend（爬）→ 向下而生→后代
exs: She is a direct descendant of early settlers in this valley. 她是这个山谷早期定居者的直系后裔。
Although he is a descendant of royalty, he lives modestly. 尽管他是王室后裔，他的生活却很简朴。

defs.cn: 降落, 家系, 侵袭, 血统；[医] 下降, 世代, 血统

words.root: de-（向下）+ scend（爬）→ 下降/降落
exs: The airplane began its descent above the foggy airport. 飞机在雾气笼罩的机场上空开始下降。
Descending from the mountain, they saw a valley hidden in mist. 从山上下来时，他们看见一个被雾气隐藏的山谷。

defs.cn: 指定, 指明, 称呼

words.root: de-（加强）+ sign（标记）→ 指定、标明
exs: The committee designated a quiet room for interviews. 委员会指定了一间安静的房间用于面试。
Having been designated mayor, he still needed formal approval. 尽管已被指定为市长，他仍需正式批准。

words.root: de-（完全）+ sol（单独）→ 无人→荒凉
exs: The desolate village had no electricity and few remaining residents. 这个荒凉的村庄没有电力，几乎没有居民留下。
Desolate after the storm, the coastal road remained closed for days. 风暴过后道路一片荒凉，这条沿海公路仍关闭数日。

words.root: dis-（离开）+patch（打包）→打包送走→派遣
exs: The manager despatched two technicians to repair the leaking pipeline before midnight. 经理派遣两名技术人员在午夜前修理泄漏的管道。
Having checked the inventory, the warehouse clerk despatched the urgent shipment within an hour. 核对库存后，仓库职员在一小时内发出了加急货物。

words.root: de-（离开）+ sper（希望）→ 失去希望→绝望地
exs: The trapped miners shouted desperately for help in the dark tunnel. 被困矿工在黑暗隧道里拼命呼救。
She clutched the letter, desperately hoping her son would return before dawn. 她紧紧攥着信，绝望地盼着儿子能在黎明前回来。

words.root: de-（撤去）+ servir（上菜）→ 撤盘后甜点
exs: The chocolate dessert melted quickly on the warm summer evening. 巧克力甜点在温暖的夏夜迅速融化了。
After dinner, guests chose a fruit dessert because they wanted something light. 晚餐后，客人们选了水果甜点，因为他们想要清淡些。

words.root: de-（加强）+stin（站）→站定→注定
exs: The director destined the quiet actress to play a leading role. 导演预定让那位安静的女演员出演主角。
Although he was destined to fail, the apprentice kept polishing the brass gears. 尽管注定失败，学徒仍继续打磨黄铜齿轮。

words.root: destine（命定）+ y → 命运
exs: The ancient sailors trusted destiny despite violent sea storms. 古代水手尽管遭遇猛烈海风暴，仍相信命运。
The young officer realized that destiny often rewards courage, not luck. 年轻军官意识到命运常常奖励勇气，而非运气。

defs.cn: 使分离, 分遣；[机] 摘下, 分离, 卸下

words.root: de-（离开）+ attach（贴上）→ 摘下
exs: The mechanic detached the old battery from the electric scooter. 机械师把旧电池从电动滑板车上拆下。
Having detached the trailer, the driver checked the cargo carefully. 拆下拖车后，司机仔细检查了货物。

defs.cn: 扣留, 扣押, 耽搁；[法] 拘留, 扣押, 留住

words.root: de-（离开）+tain（握持）→握住不放→扣留
exs: Customs officers detained the suspicious traveler for thirty minutes. 海关人员扣押可疑旅客三十分钟。
Detained at the checkpoint, the driver waited for a passport check. 在检查站被扣留，司机等待护照检查。

words.root: detect（发现）+ ive（人）→ 发现线索的人
exs: The retired detective examined the dusty footprints behind the warehouse. 退休侦探检查了仓库后面布满灰尘的脚印。
The detective noticed that the suspect’s alibi changed whenever police pressed him. 侦探注意到，每当警方追问，嫌疑人的不在场证明就会改变。

defs.cn: 发现者, 检验器, 检波器；[计] 检波器; 检测器

words.root: detect（查明）+ -or（器）→ 检测器
exs: A smoke detector saved the family during the midnight fire. 烟雾检测器在午夜火灾中救了这一家人。
The metal detector beeped when it found a hidden coin. 金属检测器发现隐藏硬币时发出哔声。

words.root: de-（向下）+terior（更坏）→向下变坏→恶化
exs: The patient's condition deteriorated rapidly after the surgery. 患者病情在手术后迅速恶化。
The soil deteriorated, losing nutrients after years of intensive farming. 经过多年集约耕作，土壤恶化并流失养分。

words.root: de-（离开）+ via（路）→ 离开道路→偏离
exs: The new policy caused many drivers to deviate from the main highway. 新政策导致许多司机偏离主干道。
If a student deviates from the approved research plan, the professor may ask for revisions. 如果学生偏离经批准的研究计划，教授可能要求修改。

defs.cn: 背离；[化] 偏差; 误差; 偏斜

words.root: de-（离开）+ via（路）→ 偏离
exs: A slight deviation in the compass confused the tired hikers. 罗盘中的轻微偏差让疲惫的徒步者困惑。
The report showed a deviation from standard procedure, alarming managers. 报告显示出对标准程序的偏离，令管理者警觉。

words.root: de-（完全）+vot（誓愿）→立誓投入→热爱
exs: Her devotion to the elderly patients impressed every nurse on the ward. 她对老年患者的热爱让病房里每位护士印象深刻。
Driven by devotion, the researcher spent nights reviewing fragile manuscripts. 出于热爱，研究员整夜审阅脆弱的手稿。

defs.cn: 吞食, 挥霍, 吞没

words.root: de-（向下）+ vor（吃）→ 吃下去→吞食
exs: The wildfire devoured several wooden houses near the mountain village. 野火吞没了山村附近几栋木屋。
She devoured the novel in one night, forgetting dinner and sleep. 她一夜读完小说，忘了吃饭和睡觉。

words.root: dia-（透过）+ gno（知）→ 查明病因
exs: The doctor diagnosed pneumonia from the X-ray images. 医生根据X光片诊断出肺炎。
Having diagnosed the illness early, the team improved patient outcomes. 由于早早诊断出疾病，团队改善了患者预后。

defs.cn: 诊断的, 有助于诊断的, 特征的
诊断, 病的征候, 诊断法；[计] 诊断的

words.root: dia-（穿过）+gnostic（知）→知病因→诊断
exs: The doctor ordered a diagnostic test to identify the infection. 医生安排诊断测试以查明感染。
The engineer ran a diagnostic program after the server crashed repeatedly. 服务器反复崩溃后，工程师运行了诊断程序。

words.root: dict（说/命令）+ ator（人）→ 命令者→独裁者
exs: The dictator banned independent newspapers and imprisoned several outspoken journalists. 独裁者禁止独立报纸并关押了几名直言不讳的记者。
After the dictator ordered the army to fire, the crowd fled into narrow alleys. 独裁者下令军队开火后，人群逃进狭窄小巷。

defs.cn: 内燃机, 柴油机, 柴油

words.root: 人名Diesel→柴油/柴油机
exs: The old diesel truck rumbled through the narrow village street. 那辆老旧柴油卡车轰隆驶过狭窄村道。
Running on diesel, the generator powered the whole farm. 这台柴油发电机为整个农场供电。

words.root: dif-（分开）+ fuse（流）→ 散开。
exs: Agricultural experts diffuse new techniques among remote villages. 农业专家在偏远村庄间传播新技术。
Spreading through the crowd, the rumor became diffuse and impossible to trace. 谣言在人群中扩散，变得弥漫且难以追溯。

defs.cn: 尊严, 高贵；[法] 尊严, 高位, 高贵

words.root: dign（值得）+ ity（名词）→ 值得尊重 → 尊严
exs: He maintained quiet dignity despite public humiliation and harsh criticism. 尽管遭受公开羞辱和严厉批评，他仍保持沉着的尊严。
The witness, fearing for her safety, still testified with dignity. 尽管担心自身安全，证人仍然有尊严地出庭作证。

words.root: di-（二）+ lemma（命题）→ 两难
exs: The manager faced a dilemma: raise prices or lose customers. 经理面临两难：涨价还是失去顾客。
Choosing which offer to accept left her in a dilemma for weeks. 选择接受哪份录用通知让她数周陷入困境。

words.root: di-（分开）+ lig（选）→ 精心挑选 → 勤奋。
exs: Her diligence earned her a promotion within months. 她的勤奋让她在几个月内获得晋升。
By checking every detail twice, the auditor showed remarkable diligence. 通过把每个细节检查两遍，审计员表现出非凡的勤奋。

words.root: di-（分开）+ lu（洗）→ 洗开 → 稀释
exs: The lab technician dilutes the acid with cold water. 实验室技术员用冷水稀释酸液。
Diluting the juice too much will make it taste watery. 果汁稀释得太厉害，味道就会变得很淡。

words.root: dinner（正餐）去词尾→dine，吃正餐/宴请。
exs: We dined the guests at a small banquet last Saturday. 我们上周六在小宴会上宴请了客人。
Having dined with the clients, the director reviewed the contract. 与客户进餐后，主任审阅了合同。

defs.cn: 文凭, 毕业证书；[医] 文凭

words.root: diplo-（折叠）+ -ma → 折叠证书 → 文凭。
exs: He displayed his diploma on the office wall. 他把文凭挂在办公室墙上。
After graduating with honors, she received a diploma from the university. 荣誉毕业后，她从大学获得了一张文凭。

defs.cn: 外交的, 老练的；[法] 外交的, 外交上的, 文献上的

words.root: diploma（折叠文书）→ 外交文件 → 外交的
exs: The ambassador gave a diplomatic speech at the summit. 大使在峰会上发表了外交辞令般的讲话。
Knowing the reporters were hostile, the minister remained diplomatic throughout the interview. 知道记者们怀有敌意，这位部长在整个采访中仍保持老练圆滑。

defs.cn: 目录, 工商名录, 指南；[计] 目录

words.root: direct（指引）+ -ory（场所/物）→ 指引目录
exs: The business directory lists local suppliers with contact details. 工商名录列出了本地供应商及联系方式。
Please save the files in the directory that you created. 请把文件保存到你创建的目录中。

defs.cn: 不合, 争论, 不一致；[法] 不一致, 不同意, 陪审团的意见不一

words.root: dis-（不）+ agree（同意）+ -ment → 不一致。
exs: The disagreement between the two departments delayed the project. 两个部门之间的分歧延误了项目。
Although they remained friends, their disagreement over housing costs grew. 尽管他们仍是朋友，但他们在住房费用上的分歧越来越大。

defs.cn: 看不见, 失踪, 消失

words.root: dis-（离开）+ appear（出现）→ 消失
exs: The disappearance of the package puzzled the customs officers. 包裹失踪让海关人员感到困惑。
Having investigated the disappearance, the police arrested two suspects. 调查了这起失踪案后，警方逮捕了两名嫌疑人。

words.root: dis-（不）+ approval（赞成）→ 不赞成
exs: The teacher showed disapproval of his late work. 老师对他迟交作业表示不赞成。
Frowning, the manager expressed disapproval of the rushed decision. 经理皱眉，对仓促决定表示不赞成。

defs.cn: 损失惨重的, 悲伤的

words.root: disaster（灾难）+ -ous（形容词）→ 灾难性的。
exs: The disastrous flood destroyed many homes near the river. 那场灾难性的洪水摧毁了河边的许多房屋。
Having ignored the warnings, the company suffered disastrous losses. 由于忽视警告，该公司遭受了惨重损失。

defs.cn: 辨别, 看清楚, 了解

words.root: dis-（分开）+ cern（筛选）→ 分辨 → 辨别
exs: Experts can discern subtle differences between genuine and forged paintings. 专家能辨别真迹与赝品之间的细微差异。
Although the fog was thick, she discerned a figure near the gate. 尽管雾很浓，她还是辨认出大门附近有个身影。

words.root: dis-（不）+ content（满足）+ -ed → 不满意
exs: The discontented residents gathered outside the city hall. 不满的居民聚集在市政厅外。
Feeling discontented with the salary, he searched for another job. 因对薪水不满，他寻找另一份工作。

words.root: dis-（分开）+ curs（跑）→ 来回跑 → 论述。
exs: The professor's discourse on climate change attracted students. 教授关于气候变化的演讲吸引了学生。
Listening carefully, the audience followed the political discourse without interruption. 听众认真聆听，不间断地跟上政治演讲。

defs.cn: 不符合, 差异, 不相符之处；[化] 不符值; 偏差值

words.root: dis-（分开）+ crep（响）→ 不一致 → 差异
exs: A small discrepancy appeared between the two financial reports. 两份财务报告之间出现了细微差异。
Noticing the discrepancy, the auditor requested additional documents from the client. 发现差异后，审计员要求客户提供额外文件。

defs.cn: 不连续的, 离散的；[计] 离散的

words.root: dis-（分开）+ 词根cret（分离）→ 离散
exs: Data were divided into discrete categories by age group. 数据按年龄组分为离散类别。
Discrete categories, when plotted on a graph, reveal clear gaps. 离散类别在图上绘制时显示出明显间隔。

defs.cn: 使受耻辱, 使失体面

words.root: dis-（离开）+ grace（体面）→ 失体面
exs: The scandal brought disgrace to the entire family. 丑闻使整个家族蒙受耻辱。
Disgraced by the leaked documents, the minister resigned before the vote. 因文件泄露而受辱，部长在投票前辞职。

defs.cn: 使醒悟, 使幻想破灭

words.root: dis-(离开)+illusion(幻象)→使幻象离开→醒悟
exs: The repeated failures quickly disillusioned the young recruits. 反复的失败很快让年轻新兵幻想破灭。
When the promised reforms never arrived, voters were deeply disillusioned. 当承诺的改革迟迟没有到来时，选民深感幻灭。

defs.cn: 幻想破灭了的, 大失所望的, 醒悟了的

words.root: dis-（去除）+ illusion（幻象）→ 幻象破灭
exs: The veteran teacher became disillusioned with the new administrative policy. 这位资深教师对新的行政政策感到幻灭。
After volunteering for months, she felt disillusioned when the charity ignored local needs. 做了几个月志愿者后，当慈善机构忽视当地需求时，她感到幻灭。

words.root: 惊闻坏消息，心沉如坠石
exs: The sudden closure filled the workers with dismay. 突然倒闭令工人们沮丧。
Seeing the empty factory, the old manager felt deep dismay. 看到空荡荡的工厂，老经理深感沮丧。

defs.cn: 不服从, 不孝, 违反

words.root: dis-（否定）+ obedience（服从）→ 不服从
exs: The student's disobedience led to a formal warning from the school committee. 这名学生的不服从行为导致学校委员会发出正式警告。
Although the new regulation was unpopular, widespread disobedience threatened social order. 尽管新规不受欢迎，但普遍的不服从行为威胁了社会秩序。

defs.cn: 使失去方向, 使迷惑

words.root: dis-（去除）+ orient（定向）→ 失去方向
exs: The sudden change in lighting can disorient elderly patients in the hospital. 灯光的突然变化会让医院里的老年患者迷失方向。
The maze-like streets can disorient him when he walks through the unfamiliar city at night. 当他夜间穿过陌生城市时，迷宫般的街道会让他迷失方向。

defs.cn: 派遣, 急件；[计] 调度

words.root: 把任务派出去送急件，像分派快送
exs: The company dispatched a repair team to the site. 公司派维修队去现场。
Dispatched by headquarters, the urgent message arrived before dawn. 由总部发出的急件在黎明前到达。

words.root: dis-(分开)+pens(支付)→分发/豁免
exs: The pharmacy dispenses vaccines to eligible residents every Tuesday. 这家药房每周二向符合条件的居民分发疫苗。
The university dispensed with the old rule, allowing students to choose courses freely. 大学废除了旧规定，允许学生自由选课。

defs.cn: 分散, 传播, 散开

words.root: dis-（分开）+ 像separate → 分散
exs: The company will disperse its staff across three offices. 公司将把员工分散到三个办公室。
As the fog clears, the crowd will disperse quickly. 雾散后，人群会很快散去。

defs.cn: 移置, 替换, 转移

words.root: dis-（离开）+ place（地方）→ 离开原位
exs: New technology can displace many manual jobs in factories. 新技术能取代工厂里许多体力岗位。
Displaced by the dam project, villagers moved to higher ground. 因大坝工程被迫迁移的村民搬到高地。

defs.cn: 换置, 移位, 移动, 取代；[化] 顶替展开法

words.root: dis-（离开）+ place（放）→ 移开位置 → 取代
exs: The displacement of coastal villages by rising seas forced many families to relocate. 海平面上升导致沿海村庄迁移，迫使许多家庭重新安置。
As the factory automated its assembly line, displacement of workers became a serious social issue. 随着工厂装配线实现自动化，工人被取代成了一个严重的社会问题。

defs.cn: 性情, 处置, 处理, 布置；[医] 素因, 性情

words.root: dis-（分开）+ posit（放置）→ 布置、倾向
exs: Her cheerful disposition made her popular among classmates. 她开朗的性情使她在同学中很受欢迎。
The committee's disposition of the funds surprised everyone because it lacked transparency. 委员会对资金的处置令所有人惊讶，因为它缺乏透明度。

words.root: dis-（不）+ proportion（比例）→ 不成比例
exs: The punishment seemed disproportionate to the minor offense. 处罚似乎与轻微过错不成比例。
Resources are disproportionate when compared with the growing demand. 与不断增长的需求相比，资源分配不成比例。

words.root: dis-(不)+regard(重视)→漠视
exs: The manager's disregard for safety led to a serious accident. 经理对安全的漠视导致了一场严重事故。
Ignoring the warning, the driver disregarded the speed limit and crashed. 无视警告，司机不顾限速并撞了车。

words.root: dis-（分开）+ rupt（破）→ 打破、中断
exs: Heavy rain can disrupt the outdoor graduation ceremony. 大雨会打乱户外毕业典礼。
Striking workers disrupt production until the company agrees to new safety rules. 罢工工人扰乱生产，直到公司同意新的安全规则。

defs.cn: 分裂的, 破坏(性)的；[计] 击穿的, 中断的

words.root: dis-（分开）+ rupt（断）→ 打断、破坏
exs: The strike caused disruptive delays across the city. 罢工造成全市破坏性延误。
Disruptive technologies, which challenge old industries, attract many investors. 挑战旧产业的颠覆性技术吸引许多投资者。

words.root: dis-(不)+satisfy(满足)→不满
exs: Widespread dissatisfaction grew over the company's new pay policy. 对公司新的薪酬政策，不满情绪蔓延。
Having waited months for answers, employees voiced dissatisfaction at the meeting. 等了几个月仍未得到答复，员工在会议上表达了不满。

defs.cn: 伤害, 帮倒忙的行为

words.root: dis-（否定）+ service（服务）→ 帮倒忙
exs: Overprotective parents often do a disservice to their teenagers. 过度保护的父母常常对青少年帮倒忙。
The manager did a disservice when he delayed the necessary repairs. 经理推迟必要维修时帮了倒忙。

defs.cn: 散失, 驱散, 浪费

words.root: dis-（分开）+ -ate（动词）→ 使散开→消散/浪费
exs: He dissipated his inheritance through reckless gambling and poor investments. 他通过鲁莽赌博和糟糕投资挥霍了遗产。
As the crowd dissipated after the concert, the police restored order near the station. 音乐会后人群散去，警方在车站附近恢复了秩序。

defs.cn: vi. 蒸馏, 提取...的精华, 用蒸馏法提取

words.root: de-（向下）+ stil（滴）→ 蒸馏、提炼
exs: The chemists distil the herbal essence slowly to preserve its fragrance. 化学家慢慢蒸馏草本精华，以保留其香气。
Distilling the wine twice, the workers removed impurities and concentrated its delicate aroma. 工人两次蒸馏酒液，去除杂质并浓缩其细腻香气。

words.root: distinct（独特的）+ -ive（形容词）→ 有特色的。
exs: The museum has a distinctive collection of Ming Dynasty ceramics. 这家博物馆收藏着一批颇具特色的明代瓷器。
Having examined the fingerprints, the detective noticed a distinctive pattern that revealed the suspect's identity. 检查完指纹后，侦探注意到一种独特纹路，揭示了嫌疑人的身份。

defs.cn: 显然地, 明显地, 清楚地

words.root: dis-（分开）+ tinct（标记）→ 分得清→明显
exs: Her distinctly stronger voice reassured the worried parents. 她明显更洪亮的声音让担忧的父母安心。
Standing apart from the crowd, the guide spoke distinctly enough for everyone to hear. 站在人群外，导游说话清晰得足以让每个人听见。

defs.cn: 扭曲, 歪曲；[法] 歪区, 曲解, 纂改

words.root: dis-（分开）+ tort（扭）→ 扭曲、歪曲
exs: The heat gradually distorted the plastic ruler during the outdoor experiment. 热量在户外实验中逐渐扭曲了塑料尺。
The article distorted the facts because the reporter relied on a biased source. 这篇文章歪曲事实，因为记者依赖了带有偏见的消息来源。

defs.cn: 扭曲, 变形, 曲解；[计] 畸变; 失真

words.root: dis-（分开）+ tort（扭）+ -ion（名词）→ 扭曲、失真。
exs: The microphone caused noticeable distortion during the live broadcast. 麦克风在直播中造成了明显失真。
Fearing public backlash, the editor removed the quotation to avoid distortion of the minister's original remarks. 担心公众反弹，编辑删除了引语，以避免曲解部长的原话。

defs.cn: 转移, 分心, 使发狂

words.root: dis-（离开）+ tract（拉）→ 拉走注意力→使分心
exs: Loud construction work outside the library distracted the students from revision. 图书馆外嘈杂的施工使学生们无法专心复习。
While she tried to concentrate, his constant questions distracted her from the essay. 当她试图集中注意力时，他不断提问使她无法专心写论文。

defs.cn: 扰乱, 不安, 忧虑；[化] 扰动; 干扰; 失调

words.root: dis-（加强）+ turb（搅动）+ -ance → 扰乱
exs: The sudden disturbance in the library made the students glance up from their books. 图书馆里突发的骚乱让学生们从书本上抬起头来。
The long-term disturbance caused by traffic noise reduced residents’ sleep quality. 交通噪声造成的长期干扰降低了居民的睡眠质量。

words.root: di-（分开）+ verg（转向）→ 岔开、分歧。
exs: The two hiking trails diverge near the old stone bridge. 两条徒步小径在旧石桥附近岔开。
As the debate continued, their opinions diverged sharply over whether the new policy would help rural schools. 随着辩论继续，他们在政策是否有助于乡村学校的问题上产生严重分歧。

words.root: divers（不同）+ -fy（使）→ 使多样
exs: The small factory diversified its products during the recession. 这家小工厂在经济衰退期间使产品多样化。
By diversifying into solar panels, the company reduced its dependence on oil. 通过转向太阳能板业务，该公司降低了对石油的依赖。

words.root: di-（分开）+ vert（转）+ -ion → 转向、转移
exs: The police created a diversion to move the injured worker away from danger. 警方制造声东击西，以便把受伤工人移离危险。
The diversion of river water saved the town, although it harmed downstream farms. 河水改道救了小镇，尽管它损害了下游农田。

words.root: di-（分开）+ vert（转）→ 转移、转向。
exs: The city built a new ring road to divert heavy traffic. 该市修建了一条新环路以分流重型交通。
To keep children occupied during the storm, the teacher diverted their attention with a short storytelling game. 为了在暴风雨期间让孩子们有事可做，老师用一个简短讲故事游戏转移了他们的注意力。

defs.cn: 神的, 神圣的, 非凡的

words.root: div-（神）+ -ine（形容词）→ 神的
exs: The poet described the mountain lake as a divine mirror of dawn. 诗人把山间湖泊描绘成黎明时分的神圣镜子。
Having studied the ancient texts, the scholar interpreted the oracle as divine guidance. 研究过古代文献后，学者将神谕解释为神的指引。

defs.cn: 晕眩的, 眼花缭乱的

words.root: 画面联想：眼前旋转，像晕车般发晕
exs: The dizzy passenger held the railing tightly and felt sick. 眩晕的乘客紧紧抓住扶手，感到恶心。
Feeling dizzy, the student leaned against the wall before the lecture began. 感到头晕，学生在讲座开始前靠墙站着。

defs.cn: 教条, 学说；[医] 学说

words.root: doc（教）+ -trine（名词）→ 学说、教条。
exs: The professor challenged a widely accepted doctrine about economic growth. 这位教授挑战了一个被广泛接受的关于经济增长的学说。
Believing the doctrine would justify censorship, the journalist published evidence showing its harmful effects on public debate. 认为该学说会为审查制度辩护，记者发表了证据，显示它对公共辩论的危害。

words.root: document（文件）+ -ary（名词/形容词）→ 记录片/文件的
exs: The documentary about coastal birds won an international award last spring. 这部关于海岸鸟类的纪录片去年春天获得国际奖项。
Filmed over three years, the documentary reveals how rising seas destroy villages. 历时三年拍摄的这部纪录片揭示了海平面上升如何摧毁村庄。

defs.cn: 领域, 领土, 产业, 范围；[计] 域, 区域, 支配命令

words.root: dom-（统治）+ ain → 统治范围 → 领域
exs: The professor’s domain includes artificial intelligence, ethics, and public policy. 教授的领域包括人工智能、伦理和公共政策。
The company expanded into a new domain, although competitors challenged its patents. 公司拓展到新领域，尽管竞争对手挑战其专利。

words.root: dome：像倒扣的大碗，形成圆顶。
exs: The library's glass dome lets natural light fill the reading room. 图书馆的玻璃圆顶让自然光充满阅览室。
After the snow melted, workers repaired the dome that covered the historic concert hall. 雪融化后，工人们修缮了覆盖历史音乐厅的圆顶。

words.root: don-（给予）+ -ate动词后缀→给予→捐赠
exs: The company donated medical supplies to rural schools last month. 该公司上个月向农村学校捐赠了医疗用品。
After seeing the flood footage, volunteers organized a campaign to donate warm clothes. 看到洪水画面后，志愿者们组织了一场捐赠保暖衣物的活动。

defs.cn: 厄运, 不幸, 法律, 宣告, 判决, 死亡

words.root: doom源自古英语“法令/审判”→判决、厄运。
exs: The king's cruel decree sealed the prisoner's doom. 国王残酷的法令宣判了囚犯的命运。
Doomed to failure, the startup ignored the market warning signs. 注定失败，这家初创公司忽视了市场预警信号。

defs.cn: 睡眠状态的, 静止的；[医] 休眠的, 不活动的, 休止的

words.root: dorm（睡）+ -ant（形容词）→ 睡着的→休眠。
exs: The seed remained dormant throughout the cold winter. 种子在整个寒冷冬季保持休眠状态。
Volcanic activity has decreased since the volcano became dormant. 自从火山进入休眠状态以来，火山活动已经减少。

words.root: dove 鸽→和平；dive过去式同形→跳水
exs: A white dove symbolizes peace in many cultures. 白色鸽子在许多文化中象征和平。
She dove into the pool after the coach blew the whistle. 教练吹哨后，她跳进了泳池。

defs.cn: (尤指经济方面的)衰退, 下降趋势；[电] 低迷时期

words.root: down（向下）+ turn（转向）→经济向下→衰退。
exs: The country entered a severe economic downturn last winter. 该国去年冬天陷入严重经济衰退。
With consumer spending falling sharply, the downturn forced the company to cut production. 随着消费支出急剧下降，经济衰退迫使该公司削减产量。

defs.cn: 排水；[医] 引流[法], 导液[法], 排水[设备]

words.root: drain（排干）+ -age（名词）→ 排水系统/过程。
exs: The farm's poor drainage left the soil flooded after heavy rain. 农场排水不畅，大雨后土壤被淹。
Engineers installed a new drainage system to prevent basement flooding. 工程师安装了新的排水系统，以防地下室进水。

defs.cn: 激烈的；[医] 峻泻药, 剧烈的

words.root: drast-（行动）+ -ic→行动猛烈→激烈的
exs: The government took drastic measures to curb rising housing prices. 政府采取了激烈措施来抑制不断上涨的房价。
Because sales fell sharply, the manager made a drastic change to the pricing policy. 因为销售额急剧下降，经理对定价政策做了剧烈调整。

defs.cn: 缺点, 退税；[法] 退款, 退税

words.root: draw（拉）+ back（回）→拉后腿→缺点。
exs: The main drawback of the plan is its high cost. 该方案的主要缺点是成本过高。
The company applied for a tax drawback after exporting the goods. 公司在出口货物后申请了退税。

words.root: dread（恐惧）+ -ful（充满）→ 令人恐惧的。
exs: The dreadful storm damaged many houses along the coast. 可怕的暴风雨损坏了沿海许多房屋。
It was dreadful that the old hospital lacked basic medical supplies. 这家老医院缺乏基本医疗用品，这很糟糕。

words.root: dub-（二）→犹豫两难→可疑的
exs: The witness gave a dubious answer under repeated questioning. 证人在反复追问下给出了可疑的回答。
Although the report looked promising, investors remained dubious about its long-term profits. 尽管报告看起来有前景，投资者仍对其长期利润持怀疑态度。

words.root: duc/dux（领袖）→公爵。
exs: The duke owned a vast estate in northern England. 这位公爵在英格兰北部拥有一大片庄园。
The duke, having inherited the title, struggled to modernize his estates. 这位公爵继承爵位后，努力使他的庄园现代化。

defs.cn: 钝地, 迟钝地, 不清楚地

words.root: dull（钝的）+ -ly（副词）→ 迟钝地。
exs: The blade cut the paper dully and left ragged edges. 刀片迟钝地切纸，留下参差不齐的边缘。
He watched the lecture dully, because the professor spoke without examples. 他迟钝地听着讲座，因为教授讲课时没有例子。

defs.cn: 副本, 复本, 复制品
复制, 使加倍；[计] 复制

words.root: du-（二）+ plic（折叠）→折成两份→副本
exs: Please email a duplicate of the signed contract to the client. 请把已签署合同的副本通过电子邮件发送给客户。
After scanning the document, the clerk created a duplicate to prevent data loss. 扫描文件后，职员制作了一份副本以防数据丢失。

words.root: 古诺斯dvergr→矮人。
exs: The garden contained a statue of a friendly dwarf. 花园里有一座友善的小矮人雕像。
Dwarfed by the skyscraper, the old house looked tiny and fragile. 被摩天大楼衬托得矮小，老房子显得又小又脆弱。

defs.cn: 居住, 居住(于), 存在(于)

words.root: 古英语 dwellan（居住）→ 居住、停留。
exs: The family will dwell in a small village for years. 这个家庭将在一个小村庄居住多年。
Do not dwell on past failures, or you will lose confidence. 不要沉溺于过去的失败，否则你会失去信心。

defs.cn: 动力的, 动态的, 动力学的, (褒)有生气的, 有力的, 能动的, 精悍的, 机能上的
动力, 动态, 原动力；[计] 动态的

words.root: dynam-（力量）+ -ical形容词→动力的
exs: The lecture introduced basic concepts of dynamical systems to freshmen. 讲座向新生介绍了动力学系统的基本概念。
When forces act unevenly, the motion becomes more complex in a dynamical model. 当力作用不均匀时，动力学模型中的运动变得更复杂。

defs.cn: 发电机；[医] 电机, 发电机

words.root: dynam（力量）+ o→发电机。
exs: The old dynamo powered the village during the storm. 那台旧发电机在暴风雨期间为村庄供电。
The dynamo converted mechanical energy into electricity, supplying the factory. 发电机将机械能转化为电能，为工厂供电。

defs.cn: 所赚的钱, 工资, 收入；[经] 工资, 收入, 收益, 盈余

words.root: earn（赚）+ -ings（名词）→ 赚到的钱。
exs: Her monthly earnings now cover rent, groceries, and transport. 她现在的月收入可支付房租、食品和交通。
The company reported higher earnings because demand for its products grew. 公司报告收益更高，因为对其产品的需求增长。

defs.cn: 陶器；[化] 陶器; 土器

words.root: earthen（泥土的）+ ware（器物）→ 陶器
exs: The museum displayed ancient earthenware pieces from a riverbank village. 博物馆展出了来自河岸村庄的古代陶器制品。
Earthenware jars, which held grain for winter, were found beneath the burned floor. 存放过冬粮食的陶罐在烧毁的地板下被发现。

words.root: east + -ward（方向）→ 向东
exs: The migration route runs eastward across the Sahel during autumn. 迁徙路线在秋季向东穿过萨赫勒地区。
The river, bending eastward, eventually reaches the Black Sea. 这条河向东蜿蜒，最终流入黑海。

defs.cn: 古怪的, 反常的, 不同圆心的

words.root: ec-（出）+ centr（中心）→ 偏离中心 → 古怪。
exs: The eccentric collector keeps his workshop locked and talks only to his cat. 这位古怪的收藏家把工作室锁着，只跟他的猫说话。
Although widely regarded as eccentric, she designs eccentric gears that reduce vibration in the machine. 虽然她被视为古怪，但她设计的偏心齿轮能减少机器振动。

defs.cn: 日食, 月食, (地位名誉等的)消失
引起日食, 引起月食, 使黯然失色

words.root: 日/月被黑影遮住→食；光芒被盖过→黯然失色
exs: A rare solar eclipse darkened the desert at noon. 一次罕见的日食使正午的沙漠变暗。
Her new novel eclipsed earlier works that had won several literary prizes. 她的新小说盖过了曾获得多项文学奖的早期作品。

defs.cn: 生态学, 社会生态学；[化] 生态学

words.root: eco-（生态/家）+ -logy（学科）→ 生态学
exs: Urban ecology examines species interactions in city environments. 城市生态学研究城市环境中的物种相互作用。
Many students choose ecology because they care about biodiversity loss. 许多学生选择生态学，因为他们关心生物多样性丧失。

defs.cn: 节约地, 不浪费地, 节省地, 节俭地, 在经济上, 在经济学上

words.root: economic（经济的）+ -ally（副词）→ 在经济上/节约地。
exs: The family renovated the old house economically with donated furniture. 这家人用捐赠的家具省钱地翻修了旧房子。
If the factory operates economically, it can survive the recession and protect jobs. 如果工厂节约经营，就能挺过衰退并保住岗位。

defs.cn: 生态系统；[医] 生态系

words.root: eco-（生态）+ system（系统）→ 生态系统
exs: A coral reef ecosystem supports thousands of marine species. 珊瑚礁生态系统支撑着数千种海洋生物。
The forest ecosystem, which stores carbon and filters water, needs legal protection. 储存碳并净化水分的森林生态系统需要法律保护。

words.root: ed-（吃）+ -ible（能…的）→ 可吃的
exs: Fresh berries are edible and rich in antioxidants. 新鲜浆果可食用，且富含抗氧化剂。
The chef warned that not all bright flowers are edible. 厨师警告说，并非所有鲜艳的花都可食用。

defs.cn: 编辑, 编校, 修订, 剪辑；[计] 编辑; DOS外部命令:该命令是一个用于编辑文本文件的全屏幕编辑程序

words.root: e-（出）+ dit（给）→ 给出文稿 → 编辑。
exs: She edits the magazine column every Friday before the press deadline. 她每周五在付印截止前编辑杂志专栏。
Having edited the footage carefully, the director removed the shaky shots. 仔细剪辑素材后，导演删掉了晃动的镜头。

words.root: ego=拉丁语“我”→ 自我
exs: A healthy ego helps students handle criticism without anxiety. 健康的自我意识有助于学生从容应对批评。
His inflated ego made him reject advice that could have improved the design. 他膨胀的自我让他拒绝了本可改进设计的建议。

words.root: Egypt（埃及）+ -ian（…人/…的）→ 埃及人/埃及的
exs: An Egyptian guide explained the ancient temple to tourists. 一位埃及导游向游客讲解这座古庙。
Egyptian cotton, grown along the Nile, is prized for its softness. 沿尼罗河种植的埃及棉因柔软而受推崇。

defs.cn: 逐放, 放逐, 喷射；[化] 排出

words.root: e-（出）+ ject（投掷）→ 投出 → 喷出/逐出。
exs: The machine ejects plastic parts onto the conveyor belt. 机器将塑料零件喷射到传送带上。
The pilot ejected from the aircraft as the engine caught fire. 发动机起火时，飞行员从飞机上弹射逃生。

words.root: e-（出）+ laps（滑落）→ 时间流逝→逝去
exs: Three weeks elapsed during the quiet summer in the village. 在乡村宁静的夏季，三周过去了。
Years had elapsed before the town rebuilt the bridge that collapsed in the flood. 多年过去后，该镇才重建了洪水中坍塌的桥梁。

defs.cn: 电学家, 电气技师, 电工；[化] 电工; 电气工人

words.root: electric（电的）+ -ian（从事者）→ 电工
exs: A qualified electrician installed new lights in the office. 一名合格电工在办公室安装了新灯。
The electrician checked the wiring before he repaired the motor. 电工在修理电机前检查了线路。

defs.cn: 电极；[化] 电极; 焊条; 电焊条

words.root: electro（电）+ hodos（路）→ 电流之路 → 电极。
exs: The damaged electrode needs replacement during routine maintenance. 损坏的电极需要在常规维护中更换。
When the electrode heats up, current flows through the salt solution. 当电极升温时，电流通过盐溶液。

defs.cn: 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的

words.root: e-（出）+ leg（挑选）→ 挑出来的→优雅的
exs: The elegant hall impressed every delegate at the opening. 优雅的大厅给开幕式上的每位代表留下了深刻印象。
Her elegant gown, designed with silver thread, reflected the lights of the ballroom. 她用银线装饰的优雅礼服映照出舞厅的灯光。

words.root: element（元素）+ -al（…的）→ 元素的/基本的
exs: Water is an elemental substance in many ancient theories. 水在许多古代理论中是一种基本物质。
The storm had an elemental force that frightened the villagers. 这场风暴具有令村民恐惧的原始力量。

defs.cn: 举起, 提拔, 鼓舞

words.root: e-（出）+ lev（轻）→ 举起 → 提升。
exs: The crane elevated the steel beam above the unfinished bridge. 起重机把钢梁提升到未完工桥梁上方。
Her inspiring speech elevated the team, whose morale had fallen after the loss. 她鼓舞人心的讲话提振了这支因失败而士气低落的队伍。

defs.cn: 海拔, 提高, 仰角；[计] 仰角

words.root: e-（向外）+ lev（举起）→ 抬高/海拔
exs: The village sits at an elevation of 1,200 meters above sea level. 这个村庄海拔1200米。
Before the elevation was measured, surveyors climbed the ridge to set up instruments. 在测量海拔之前，勘测人员爬上山脊设置仪器。

defs.cn: 引出, 推导出, 引起

words.root: e-（向外）+ lac（引诱）→ 诱出
exs: The teacher elicited a surprising answer from the shy student. 老师引导害羞学生给出了一个令人惊讶的回答。
By asking open questions, the interviewer elicited detailed stories about rural life. 通过提出开放式问题，采访者引出了关于乡村生活的详细故事。

defs.cn: 有资格当选的, 合格的
有资格者, 合格者, 适任者

words.root: e-（出）+ lig（选）→ 选出来 → 有资格
exs: Only graduates with a valid certificate are eligible for this teaching position. 只有持有有效证书的毕业生才有资格担任这一教职。
Applicants who submit incomplete documents will not be eligible for the scholarship until they provide proof. 提交不完整材料的申请者在提供证明之前没有资格获得该奖学金。

defs.cn: 椭圆的；[医] 椭圆形的

words.root: ellipse（椭圆）+ -ical → 椭圆形的
exs: The elliptical orbit of the satellite brings it close to Earth every night. 卫星的椭圆轨道使其每晚接近地球。
Using an elliptical equation, the engineer calculated the dimensions of the curved hall. 工程师利用椭圆方程计算了弧形大厅的尺寸。

defs.cn: 口才, 雄辩术, 雄辩；[法] 善辩, 口才

words.root: e-（出）+ loqu（说）+ -ence → 口才
exs: Her eloquence moved the audience to tears during the graduation speech. 她的口才在毕业演讲中令听众感动落泪。
The lawyer's eloquence, which impressed the jury, turned the trial around. 律师的口才给陪审团留下深刻印象，扭转了审判局势。

defs.cn: 雄辩的, 有口才的, 有说服力的

words.root: e-（出）+ loqu（说）→ 说得出来 → 雄辩
exs: Her eloquent speech convinced many skeptical voters before the election. 她雄辩的演讲在选举前说服了许多持怀疑态度的选民。
Having practiced daily, he delivered an eloquent argument that impressed the judges. 经过每天练习，他发表了令评委印象深刻的雄辩论述。

defs.cn: 乘船, 着手, 从事, 上飞机
使上船, 使上飞机, 使从事

words.root: em-（进入）+ bark（小船）→ 上船/从事
exs: Passengers will embark on the cruise ship tonight. 乘客今晚将登上这艘邮轮。
After embarking on the project, the team realized the deadline was unrealistic. 在着手该项目之后，团队意识到截止日期不现实。

defs.cn: 大使馆, 大使馆全体人员；[经] 大使馆

words.root: 大使办公的馆所→大使馆
exs: The embassy issued emergency passports to stranded citizens last night. 大使馆昨晚向滞留公民签发了紧急护照。
While working at the embassy, she translated documents for visiting officials. 在大使馆工作时，她为来访官员翻译文件。

defs.cn: 刺绣品, 粉饰, 刺绣

words.root: 针线穿入布面，形成花纹→刺绣
exs: The silk embroidery on the cushion shows traditional Chinese patterns. 靠垫上的丝绸刺绣呈现传统中国图案。
Embroidery, which requires patience, can decorate garments with delicate floral designs. 刺绣需要耐心，能用精致花卉图案装饰衣物。

words.root: e-（出）+ migr（迁移）→ 迁出/移民
exs: Many families emigrate to Canada for better job opportunities. 许多家庭为更好的工作机会移居加拿大。
Having emigrated from Iran, she still celebrated Nowruz in her new city. 从伊朗移居后，她仍在新城市庆祝诺鲁兹节。

defs.cn: 发射, 射出, 发行；[医] 发射, 遗精

words.root: e-（向外）+ miss（送）→ 送出/排放
exs: The car's emission exceeded the city's strict environmental standards yesterday. 这辆车的排放昨天超过了该市严格的环境标准。
Factories reduced sulfur emission by installing new filters on chimneys. 工厂通过在烟囱上安装新过滤器减少了硫排放。

defs.cn: 完全跟据经验的, 经验主义的；[医] 经验主义的

words.root: en-（内）+ peir（试）→ 经验性的
exs: The researchers collected empirical data through repeated laboratory experiments. 研究人员通过重复实验室实验收集实证数据。
A theory is credible only when empirical evidence supports its predictions. 只有当实证证据支持其预测时，理论才可信。

words.root: en-（使）+ chant（歌/咒语）→ 施魔法/迷住
exs: The old castle enchanted every visitor with its hidden gardens. 这座古老城堡以隐秘花园迷住了每位游客。
Enchanted by the violinist, the audience remained silent until the last note faded. 被小提琴家迷住的观众保持安静，直到最后一个音符消失。

defs.cn: 附件, 围墙, 围绕；[化] 机壳; 外壳

words.root: en-（在内）+ clos（关闭）→ 围住之物
exs: The garden enclosure kept rabbits away from the young vegetables. 花园围墙把兔子挡在嫩菜之外。
He sent the email, including the signed contract as an enclosure. 他发送邮件时，将签署好的合同作为附件包含在内。

defs.cn: 危及；[法] 使危险, 危及

words.root: en-（使）+ danger（危险）→ 使危险
exs: Deforestation can endanger many rare species in tropical forests. 砍伐森林会使热带雨林中的许多稀有物种濒危。
Failing to enforce fishing limits endangers marine ecosystems and local livelihoods. 不执行捕鱼限制会危及海洋生态系统和当地生计。

words.root: en-（使）+ devoir（责任）→ 尽力
exs: The students endeavor to improve their spoken English every morning. 学生们每天早晨努力提升英语口语。
Endeavoring to finish the report, he skipped lunch and worked through the night. 为完成报告，他不吃午餐，整夜工作。

defs.cn: 捐赠, 捐助, 赋予；[法] 赠送财产给, 分给寡妇一份遗产, 授与

words.root: en-（使）+ dow（财产）→ 赋予/捐赠
exs: The wealthy couple endowed a scholarship for talented rural students. 这对富裕夫妇为有才华的农村学生捐设了奖学金。
Having studied abroad, she endowed the school with a new library. 留学归来后，她为学校捐建了一座新图书馆。

defs.cn: 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性；[机] 持九性

words.root: en-（使）+ dur（持续）→ 持久性
exs: Marathon runners need endurance to maintain a steady pace. 马拉松跑者需要耐力来保持稳定配速。
Endurance, which develops through training, helps athletes overcome painful late-stage fatigue. 通过训练培养的耐力帮助运动员克服痛苦的后期疲劳。

defs.cn: 精力充沛的, 积极的

words.root: en-（内）+erg（做功）→内在做功→精力充沛
exs: The energetic freshman joined three clubs and still finished every assignment before midnight. 这位精力充沛的新生加入了三个社团，仍能午夜前完成所有作业。
Seeing the exhausted team, she offered energetic support that helped them finish the project early. 看到疲惫的团队，她提供了积极的帮助，使他们提前完成项目。

defs.cn: 使活跃, 激励, 供给...能量；[电] 激励

words.root: en-（使）+ erg（工作）→ 使有能量→激励
exs: A brisk morning walk energizes the whole office. 清晨快走能让整个办公室振奋起来。
Holding a short team huddle energizes employees, who return to their desks feeling more focused. 开一个简短的团队碰头会让员工振奋，他们回到办公桌前时更加专注。

defs.cn: 诺言, 约会, 婚约, 交战；[医] 衔接

words.root: en-（使）+ gage（保证）→ 约定、婚约。
exs: The couple announced their engagement at a small family dinner last Sunday. 这对夫妇上周日在一次小型家庭晚餐上宣布订婚。
Although the engagement was postponed, both families still hoped to celebrate it soon. 尽管订婚被推迟，双方家庭仍希望尽快庆祝。

defs.cn: 教育, 启发, 启蒙, 开导, 教导

words.root: en-（使）+light（光）→照亮心智→启发
exs: The guest lecture enlightened students about ethical dilemmas in artificial intelligence development. 客座讲座使学生了解人工智能开发中的伦理困境。
Reading historical records can enlighten us about how ordinary people shaped major social changes. 阅读历史记载能启发我们了解普通人如何推动重大社会变革。

words.root: en-（使）+ rich（富有）→ 使富有
exs: Diverse novels enrich students' understanding of human nature. 不同类型的小说能加深学生对人性的理解。
Traveling abroad enriches young people, who learn to appreciate unfamiliar customs and beliefs. 出国旅行能丰富年轻人的内心，让他们学会欣赏陌生的习俗与观念。

words.root: en-（进入）+ sue（跟随）→ 随之发生。
exs: Delays ensued throughout the city after the sudden power outage. 突发停电后，全市出现延误。
Having ignored the warning signs, the company soon faced problems that ensued from poor planning. 由于忽视预警信号，公司很快面临因规划不善而随之产生的问题。

defs.cn: 使成为必需, 需要, 使承担, 遗传给

words.root: en-（使）+tail（尾）→拖尾而来→需要承担
exs: The new policy will entail enormous costs and strict coordination. 新政策将需要巨额成本和严格协调。
The new regulations entail risks that many small businesses cannot absorb without government support. 新规定带来许多小企业没有政府支持便无法承受的风险。

defs.cn: 企业, 事业心, 进取心, 干事业；[计] 企业

words.root: entre-（在中间）+ prise（抓取）→ 企业
exs: The enterprise hired twenty engineers from overseas last month. 这家企业上个月从海外招聘了二十名工程师。
With strong enterprise, she launched a startup that solved local recycling problems. 凭借强烈的进取心，她创办了一家解决本地回收问题的初创公司。

defs.cn: 实体, 实存物, 存在；[计] 实体

words.root: ent（存在）+ -ity（名词）→ 实体。
exs: A corporation is a legal entity separate from its owners. 公司是独立于其所有者的法律实体。
Although the brand was sold, the entity still operates under old contracts. 尽管品牌已被出售，该实体仍按旧合同运营。

words.root: en-（使）+treat（处理）→反复求→恳求
exs: The desperate mother entreated the judge for a lighter sentence. 绝望的母亲恳求法官判处较轻刑罚。
Entreating him to reconsider, the committee warned that the plan would endanger local habitats. 委员会恳求他重新考虑，并警告该计划会危及当地栖息地。

words.root: envy（嫉妒）+ -ous（形容词）→ 嫉妒的
exs: He felt envious of his rival's national scholarship. 他嫉妒对手获得了国家奖学金。
Students may become envious when classmates receive praise for projects they did not help finish. 当同学因他们并未帮忙完成的项目获得表扬时，学生可能会心生嫉妒。

defs.cn: 周围的, 环境的；[经] 环境的, 环保的

words.root: environ（围绕）+ -ment/-al → 环境的。
exs: The city tightened environmental rules to reduce smog this winter. 该市收紧环保规定，以减少今冬雾霾。
Because the report ignored environmental risks, the project was postponed for months. 因为报告忽视了环境风险，该项目被推迟了数月。

defs.cn: 面对, 正视, 想象

words.root: en-（使）+visage（脸）→让脸浮现→想象
exs: The report envisages a future with renewable energy. 该报告设想了可再生能源普及的未来。
Envisaging possible delays, the engineers revised the schedule so that residents would not lose heat. 考虑到可能延期，工程师修改了计划，以免居民供暖中断。

defs.cn: 新纪元, 时代, 时期

words.root: epi-（在…上）+ hekein（停）→ 时代
exs: The steam engine marked an epoch in industrial history. 蒸汽机标志着工业史上的一个新时代。
Many historians regard the digital revolution as an epoch that transformed global communication. 许多历史学家把数字革命视为改变全球通信的新时代。

words.root: equ（相等）+ -ate（动词）→ 等同。
exs: Many experts equate economic growth with social progress. 许多专家将经济增长与社会进步等同起来。
Having equated speed with efficiency, the team ignored quality control. 由于把速度等同于效率，团队忽视了质量控制。

defs.cn: 赤道；[医] 赤道, 中纬线

words.root: equ（相等）+ator→平分地球线→赤道
exs: The expedition crossed the equator during a stormy night. 探险队在一个暴风雨的夜晚越过赤道。
Standing near the equator, travelers felt intense sunlight that made every shadow disappear. 站在赤道附近，旅行者感到强烈阳光使所有阴影消失。

defs.cn: 平衡, 平静, 均衡；[化] 平衡

words.root: equi-（相等）+ libr（天平）→ 平衡
exs: The market reached equilibrium after the sudden price rise. 在价格突然上涨后，市场达到了均衡。
Maintaining equilibrium requires policies that balance growth with environmental protection. 维持均衡需要平衡经济增长与环境保护的政策。

defs.cn: <法>运动队（或比赛队）及其装备

words.root: 法语 équipe（队）→ 运动队。
exs: The national equipe trained in Paris before the final match. 这支国家队在决赛前于巴黎训练。
The equipe, wearing new uniforms, entered the stadium while fans cheered. 这支身着新队服的队伍走进体育场，球迷欢呼。

defs.cn: 根除, 扑灭, 根绝, 消灭

words.root: e-（出）+ radic（根）→ 拔根 → 根除
exs: The government eradicated the disease through nationwide vaccination campaigns. 政府通过全国疫苗接种运动根除了这种疾病。
The policy aims to eradicate corruption, which undermines public trust. 该政策旨在根除腐败，这种腐败会破坏公众信任。

defs.cn: 腐蚀, 冲蚀, 侵蚀；[化] 磨耗; 侵蚀

words.root: e-（向外）+ ros（咬）→ 被咬掉 → 侵蚀
exs: Coastal erosion threatens many seaside villages every winter. 海岸侵蚀每年冬天威胁许多海边村庄。
The erosion of soil, which farmers had ignored for years, finally destroyed their crops. 农民多年忽视的土壤侵蚀最终毁掉了庄稼。

defs.cn: 任务, 差使, 使命

words.root: 跑腿送信→差使；联想跑一趟的差事。
exs: I ran a quick errand to the post office before lunch. 午饭前我去邮局跑了趟快差。
While delivering the errand, she noticed a forgotten umbrella in the lobby. 在跑腿办事时，她注意到大厅里有一把被遗忘的伞。

defs.cn: 错误的, 不正确的；[法] 错误的, 不正确的

words.root: err（错误）+ -ous（充满）→ 错误的
exs: The judge corrected the erroneous legal interpretation in court. 法官在法庭上纠正了错误的法律解释。
The conclusion is erroneous because it ignores key evidence. 该结论是错误的，因为它忽略了关键证据。

words.root: e-（向外）+ rupt（破裂）→ 爆发
exs: The dormant volcano can erupt without any warning. 休眠火山可能在没有任何预警的情况下爆发。
When pressure builds up underground, lava may erupt violently. 当地下压力积聚时，熔岩可能猛烈喷发。

defs.cn: 爆发, 喷出物, 出疹；[化] 喷发

words.root: e-出+rupt破裂→喷出、爆发。
exs: The sudden eruption of the volcano forced nearby villages to evacuate. 火山突然喷发迫使附近村民撤离。
Covered in red spots after the eruption, the patient felt intense itching. 出疹后身上布满红斑，病人感到剧烈瘙痒。

defs.cn: 护送者, 护卫者, 护航舰

words.root: 画面：军舰开道护送 → 护航
exs: A police officer escorted the witness safely home. 一名警察护送证人安全回家。
The convoy, escorted by helicopters, crossed the border. 由直升机护送的车队越过了边境。

defs.cn: 实质, 本质, 香精；[化] 香精

words.root: ess（存在）+ -ence → 存在的核心 → 本质
exs: Trust is the essence of any successful partnership. 信任是任何成功伙伴关系的本质。
The essence of his argument, reduced to one sentence, was surprisingly simple. 他的论点浓缩成一句话后，本质出奇地简单。

words.root: aisth-感觉+etic→审美、感觉。
exs: The esthetic design of the café attracted many young customers. 这家咖啡馆的审美设计吸引了许多年轻顾客。
He chose the wallpaper because its esthetic appeal matched the room. 他选择这款壁纸，因为其审美吸引力与房间相配。

defs.cn: 永恒的, 永远的, 不灭的

words.root: 画面：时间不停走，爱永恒 → 永恒
exs: The eternal flame burns brightly at the memorial. 永恒之火在纪念碑前明亮燃烧。
Living in the present makes us feel eternal. 活在当下让我们感到永恒。

defs.cn: 伦理的, 民族的, 民族特有的；[医] 伦理的, 道德的

words.root: eth（道德）+ -ical → 伦理的
exs: Ethical research protects both participants and scientific credibility. 合乎伦理的研究保护参与者也维护科学可信度。
The company refused to release data that was not ethical. 公司拒绝发布不道德的数据。

defs.cn: 道德规范；[医] 伦理学

words.root: ethos品格+ics→道德规范。
exs: Strict ethics guide medical research in this hospital. 严格的伦理规范指导这家医院的医学研究。
Companies that ignore ethics may face public backlash. 忽视道德规范的公司可能面临公众抵制。

defs.cn: 人种的, 种族的；[医] 人种的

words.root: eth（民族）+ -nic（形容词）→ 民族的
exs: The museum displays ethnic costumes from remote villages. 博物馆展出偏远村庄的民族服饰。
Studying ethnic traditions helps preserve cultural diversity today. 研究民族传统有助于在今天保护文化多样性。

defs.cn: 评估, 估价, 求值；[计] 鉴定; 评价; 求值

words.root: e-（向外）+ valu（价值）→ 评估
exs: The teacher's evaluation revealed serious writing problems today. 老师的评估今天暴露了严重的写作问题。
After careful evaluation, the committee decided which project deserved funding. 经过仔细评估，委员会决定了哪个项目值得资助。

defs.cn: 蒸发, 脱水, 消失；[化] 蒸发

words.root: e-出+vapor蒸汽→蒸发。
exs: Slow evaporation left white salt crystals on the glass tray. 缓慢蒸发在玻璃托盘上留下白色盐晶。
When sunlight struck the shallow pool, evaporation increased quickly. 阳光照到浅池时，蒸发迅速增加。

defs.cn: 平衡地, 平坦地, 平等地

words.root: even（均匀）+ -ly（副词）→ 均匀地
exs: She spread the butter evenly on warm bread. 她把黄油均匀地涂在热面包上。
The team divided the tasks evenly before starting. 团队在开始前均匀地分配了任务。

words.root: ever（永远）+ lasting（持续）→ 永恒
exs: Their friendship lasted as an everlasting bond through hardship. 他们的友谊在困境中成为永恒的纽带。
Everlasting love, which people often praise, is hard to maintain. 人们常赞美的永恒爱情很难维持。

defs.cn: 唤起, 引起, 召(魂)；[法] 提审, 移送

words.root: e-出+voc叫→唤出、引起。
exs: The old photograph evoked memories of her childhood village. 这张老照片唤起她对童年村庄的记忆。
Listening to the folk song, he evoked images of distant rivers. 听着民歌，他唤起对远方河流的画面。

defs.cn: 展开的, 进化论的, 进化的, 发展的；[计] 进化的, 改良的, 发展的

words.root: e-（出）+ volv（卷）→ 展开 → 进化的
exs: Evolutionary biology studies the development of modern species. 进化生物学研究现代物种的发展。
Researchers studying fossils found that evolutionary changes often occur gradually. 研究化石的研究人员发现进化变化通常逐渐发生。

defs.cn: 过多, 极度, 过度, 过分

words.root: ex-（向外）+ cess（走）→ 走过头 → 过度。
exs: The manager excessively criticized the junior staff during the meeting. 经理在会议上过分批评了初级员工。
Excessively relying on imported components, the factory faced severe supply-chain risks. 过度依赖进口零部件，该工厂面临严重的供应链风险。

defs.cn: 惊呼, 激烈言词, 惊叹词

words.root: ex-（向外）+ clam（喊）→ 惊呼
exs: Her sudden exclamation revealed the shocking result of the experiment. 她突然的惊呼暴露了实验的惊人结果。
The teacher's exclamation, echoing through the hall, silenced the noisy students. 老师的一声惊呼回荡在大厅，使喧闹的学生安静下来。

defs.cn: 排泄, 分泌；[医] 排泄, 分泌

words.root: ex-（向外）+ cret（分离）→ 排出体外
exs: The kidneys excrete waste products from the bloodstream. 肾脏从血流中排泄废物。
Animals excreting concentrated urine conserve water in arid regions. 排出浓缩尿液的动物在干旱地区保存水分。

defs.cn: 实行, 完成, 执行, 死刑；[计] 执行

words.root: ex-（向外）+ secut（跟随）→ 执行。
exs: The project's execution began immediately after the budget approval. 预算批准后，该项目立即开始执行。
Having completed the execution plan, the team reported to headquarters. 完成执行计划后，团队向总部汇报。

defs.cn: 例证, 例示；[法] 制作经公章证明的誊本, 例证

words.root: exempl（例子）+ -ify（使）→ 例证
exs: This ancient coin exemplifies the trade links between two distant empires. 这枚古币例证了两个遥远帝国之间的贸易联系。
The case exemplifies how a single policy can reshape urban transportation. 该案例例证了一项政策如何重塑城市交通。

defs.cn: 免税者, 被免除义务者

words.root: ex-（出）+ empt（拿）→ 拿出去 → 免除
exs: Students under eighteen are exempt from the entrance fee. 十八岁以下学生免交入场费。
Charities that are exempt from tax rely heavily on public donations. 免税的慈善机构严重依赖公众捐款。

defs.cn: 放逐, 流放, 被放逐者
放逐, 流放, 使背井离乡

words.root: ex-（向外）→ 被赶出去 → 流放。
exs: The government exiled the journalist to a remote island. 政府将记者流放至偏远岛屿。
Exiled for his political writings, the poet spent decades abroad. 因政治著作被流放，诗人旅居海外数十年。

defs.cn: 外来人, 外来物, 舶来品

words.root: exo-（外）+ -tic→ 外来的
exs: The market sells exotic fruits from Southeast Asian islands. 市场出售来自东南亚岛屿的异国水果。
Exotic plants, cultivated in greenhouses, attract tourists seeking rare botanical species. 在温室栽培的异国植物吸引寻找稀有植物物种的游客。

defs.cn: 远征, 探险队, 迅速

words.root: ex-（向外）+ ped（脚）→ 走出去 → 远征
exs: The expedition crossed the desert with limited supplies. 探险队携带有限物资穿越沙漠。
Scientists preparing for the expedition checked their equipment carefully. 为探险队做准备的科学家仔细检查了设备。

defs.cn: 实验式地, 在实验上

words.root: experiment（实验）+ -ally（副词）→ 实验地。
exs: The drug was tested experimentally on small animal groups. 该药物在小动物群体上进行了实验测试。
Experimentally, researchers adjusted the catalyst before the reaction was run. 实验上，研究人员在反应进行前调整了催化剂。

defs.cn: 实验, 试验, 实验法；[化] 实验; 实验过程

words.root: experiment（实验）+ -ation→ 过程
exs: Careful experimentation helped the team identify the faulty circuit component. 谨慎的试验帮助团队识别了故障电路元件。
By repeated experimentation, researchers discovered that the alloy weakened under heat. 通过反复试验，研究人员发现该合金受热后变弱。

defs.cn: 专家意见, 专门技术；[法] 专门知识, 专家意见

words.root: expert（专家）+ -ise → 专家技能
exs: Her expertise in statistics impressed the hiring committee. 她在统计方面的专长给招聘委员会留下深刻印象。
Companies seeking expertise in cybersecurity often hire outside consultants. 寻求网络安全专长的公司常聘请外部顾问。

defs.cn: 期满, 呼气, 断气

words.root: ex-（向外）+ spir（呼吸）→ 呼出 → 断气/期满。
exs: The contract will expire at midnight on December 31. 合同将于12月31日午夜到期。
The patient expired quietly as the hospital lights dimmed. 医院灯光变暗时，患者悄然离世。

defs.cn: 详述的, 清楚的, 直言的

words.root: ex-（向外）+ plic（折叠）→ 展开→清楚
exs: The contract contains explicit clauses about payment delays and penalties. 合同包含关于付款延迟和违约金的明确条款。
Her instructions were explicit, leaving no room for misunderstanding. 她的指示很明确，没有留下任何误解空间。

defs.cn: 开发, 开采, 剥削；[经] 开发, 剥削, 宜传

words.root: exploit（利用）+ -ation→开发/剥削
exs: The government approved the exploitation of offshore oil resources. 政府批准了近海石油资源的开发。
Employees reported cases of exploitation after discovering that managers withheld overtime pay. 员工在发现经理拖欠加班费后举报了剥削行为。

defs.cn: 探险, 踏勘, 探测；[医] 探察

words.root: 向外寻找 → 探索/探测。
exs: The geological exploration team mapped several promising mineral sites. 地质勘探团队绘制了若干有前景的矿点图。
Exploration of the deep sea continues because new species are discovered. 深海探测仍在继续，因为新物种不断被发现。

defs.cn: 阐述, 讲解, 说明, 博览会, 展览会；[经] 展览会, 集市, 义卖市场

words.root: ex-（向外）+ posit（放）+ -ion→摆出→阐述
exs: The museum held an exposition of medieval manuscripts last spring. 博物馆去年春天举办了中世纪手稿展览会。
His exposition, which clarified the economic theory, impressed the audience. 他的阐述澄清了经济理论，给观众留下深刻印象。

defs.cn: 精致的, 细腻的, 敏锐的

words.root: ex-出+quis寻求→精心寻求→精致
exs: The exquisite porcelain vase impressed every guest at the museum opening. 博物馆开幕式上，那只精致的瓷瓶令每位来宾赞叹。
Exquisite as the lace was, it required hours of patient work. 尽管蕾丝精致，它仍需要数小时的耐心制作。

defs.cn: 消失, 消灭, 废止；[化] 消光; 熄灭

words.root: 火苗被吹出 → 灭绝
exs: Rapid deforestation drives countless rare bird species toward certain extinction. 快速砍伐森林正驱使无数珍稀鸟类走向必然灭绝。
If governments fail to protect wetlands, many migratory waterfowl may face extinction within decades. 如果政府不保护湿地，许多迁徙水鸟可能在数十年内面临灭绝。

defs.cn: 熄灭, 使消亡, 压制, 使减色；[医] 消灭

words.root: ex-（出）+ stinguish（熄灭）→ 使熄灭
exs: The firefighters extinguished the kitchen blaze with foam and water. 消防员用泡沫和水扑灭了厨房大火。
Having extinguished the small fire, volunteers checked the smoldering debris. 扑灭小火后，志愿者们检查了闷烧的残骸。

defs.cn: 榨出物, 精汁, 摘录, 选段
(费力地)取出, 采掘, 榨取, 摘录, 吸取；[计] 提取

words.root: ex-出+tract拉→拉出来→提取
exs: The chemist extracted a bitter compound from the dried herb. 化学家从干草药中提取出一种苦味化合物。
Extracting key data from the report, the analyst saved considerable time. 从报告中提取关键数据，分析师节省了大量时间。

defs.cn: 抽出, 取出, 拔出术, 抽出物；[化] 萃取; 提取

words.root: ex-（出）+ tract（拉）+ -ion → 抽出 → 提取
exs: The dentist removed the wisdom tooth during a quick extraction. 牙医在一次快速拔牙中取出了智齿。
Extraction of plant oils using ethanol is safer than methods that rely on toxic solvents. 用乙醇提取植物油比依赖有毒溶剂的方法更安全。

words.root: extra-（超出）+ curricular（课程的）→ 课外的
exs: She joined three extracurricular clubs to build her college application. 她参加了三个课外社团来丰富大学申请材料。
Extracurricular activities, which consume time, can still enhance teamwork skills. 课外活动虽耗费时间，仍能提升团队合作技能。

defs.cn: 非凡, 破例, 特别, 非常, 离奇, 使人惊奇, 惊人, 特命, 特派

words.root: extra超出+ordinary普通→非凡
exs: The extraordinarily clear night sky revealed hundreds of distant stars. 格外晴朗的夜空显现出数百颗遥远的星星。
Extraordinarily talented, the young pianist amazed the audience with her improvisation. 这位年轻钢琴家才华非凡，她的即兴演奏令观众惊叹。

defs.cn: 奢侈的, 挥霍无度的, 浪费的

words.root: extra-（超出）+ vagant（漫游）→ 越轨 → 奢侈
exs: The couple made an extravagant purchase of a luxury villa near the coast. 这对夫妇在海岸附近奢侈地买了一栋豪华别墅。
Although he earned modest wages, his extravagant spending soon ruined his savings. 尽管收入不高，他挥霍无度的消费很快毁掉了积蓄。

defs.cn: 寓言, 神话, 谎言

words.root: fabul-（讲述）→ 寓言、故事
exs: The fable teaches children honesty through animal characters. 这则寓言借动物角色教导孩子诚实。
Aesop wrote many fables that expose human greed. 伊索写了许多揭露人性贪婪的寓言。

defs.cn: 制造, 建造, 装配, 伪造

words.root: fabric制作+ate→制造；也可伪造
exs: The factory fabricates lightweight frames for racing bicycles. 这家工厂制造轻量级赛车自行车车架。
Fabricated evidence misled the jury until a witness admitted the deception. 伪造的证据误导了陪审团，直到一名证人承认了欺骗。

defs.cn: 制造, 建造, 虚构的谎言；[医] 虚谈症

words.root: fabr（制作）+ -ication → 制造 → 虚构
exs: The company's fabrication of safety records misled investors for several years. 该公司伪造安全记录误导投资者数年。
Fabrication of evidence can destroy trust in courts, which rely heavily on testimony. 伪造证据会破坏公众对法院的信任，而法院高度依赖证词。

defs.cn: (多面体的)面, 方面, 琢面；[医] 小平面, 小面

words.root: fac-（面）→ 小面、方面
exs: Each facet of the diamond reflects different colors. 钻石的每个切面都反射不同色彩。
The report examines a facet of urban poverty that policymakers ignore. 报告考察了政策制定者忽视的城市贫困一面。

defs.cn: 使容易, 促进, 帮助；[法] 使容易, 使便利, 推进

words.root: fac做+ate→使易做→促进
exs: The new app facilitates daily expense tracking for small businesses. 这款新应用帮助小企业进行日常开支追踪。
Facilitated by bilingual guides, the tourists understood the historic site deeply. 在双语导游的协助下，游客们深入理解了这处历史遗迹。

defs.cn: 小派系, 内讧；[法] 宗派, 派别, 小集团

words.root: fact（做）+ -ion → 结党 → 派系
exs: A small faction inside the party opposed the proposed tax reform. 党内一个小派系反对拟议的税改。
The faction that rejected compromise eventually split from the main organization. 拒绝妥协的那个派系最终从主组织中分裂出去。

defs.cn: 奇妙的, 稀奇的, 空想的

words.root: phant-（显现/幻想）→ 奇妙的、空想的
exs: The children found the animated movie fantastic after the opening scene. 孩子们看完开场后觉得动画片很棒。
Fantastic as the proposal seemed, the committee still demanded evidence. 尽管提案看似奇妙，委员会仍要求证据。

words.root: fasc魔咒+inate→施魔咒→入迷
exs: The antique music box fascinated the children for a long afternoon. 那只古董音乐盒让孩子们着迷了一个漫长的下午。
Fascinated by ancient astronomy, she spent nights reading star charts. 她对古代天文学着迷，整夜阅读星图。

defs.cn: 迷人的, 吸引人的, 使人神魂颠倒的

words.root: fascin（迷惑）+ -ating → 迷人的
exs: The museum's fascinating collection of ancient coins attracted many young visitors. 博物馆迷人的古代钱币收藏吸引了许多年轻观众。
Watching the documentary, students found the story of glaciers fascinating. 观看纪录片时，学生们觉得冰川的故事很迷人。

defs.cn: 结扎工, 使系牢之物；[化] 紧固零件

words.root: fasten（系牢）+ -er（物）→ 紧固件
exs: A broken fastener can ruin an expensive jacket. 损坏的紧固件会毁掉一件昂贵夹克。
The designer chose a magnetic fastener that closes securely. 设计师选择了一种能牢固闭合的磁扣。

defs.cn: 完美的, 无缺点的；[化] 无故障的

words.root: fault（缺点）+ -less（无）→ 无缺点/无故障
exs: The faultless performance impressed every judge at the regional music competition yesterday. 这场无懈可击的表演在昨天的地区音乐比赛中给每位评委留下深刻印象。
Although the software update was faultless, users still reported occasional connection problems. 尽管软件更新毫无故障，用户仍报告偶发连接问题。

defs.cn: 大胆的, 勇敢的, 无畏的

words.root: fear（害怕）+ -less（无）→ 无畏
exs: The fearless firefighter rescued a trapped child from the burning building. 无畏的消防员从燃烧的建筑中救出了被困儿童。
Although smoke filled the corridor, the fearless guide led everyone safely outside. 尽管走廊充满烟雾，无畏的向导仍把所有人安全带到外面。

defs.cn: 一季所伐的木材, 折缝
凶猛的, 可怕的；fall的过去式

words.root: fall的过去式→砍倒；凶猛义联想猛兽。
exs: The lumberjack fell the huge oak tree in the forest. 伐木工在森林里砍倒了那棵巨大的橡树。
The hunter feared the fell wolf that attacked the sheep. 猎人害怕那匹袭击羊群的凶猛狼。

defs.cn: 伙伴关系, 共同参与, 团体, 奖学金, 友谊；[经] 合伙关系, 研究员薪金, 研究员基金

words.root: fellow（同伴）+ -ship（身份）→ 伙伴关系/奖学金
exs: The fellowship gave the young scientist two years of stable research funding. 这项奖学金为这位年轻科学家提供了两年稳定的研究经费。
During the fellowship, she found that collaboration improved her academic writing. 在研究员资助期间，她发现合作改善了她的学术写作。

defs.cn: 女性的, 阴性的, 柔弱的；[医] 女性的, 雌性的

words.root: femin（女性）+ -ine（形容词）→ 女性的
exs: The detective noted feminine handwriting on the anonymous letter. 侦探注意到匿名信上有女性化的笔迹。
Wearing a feminine dress, she felt elegant at the charity gala. 穿着女性化礼服，她在慈善晚会上显得优雅。

defs.cn: 铁的, 含铁的, 亚铁的；[医] 亚铁的

words.root: ferr-（铁）+ -ous（形容词）→ 含铁的。
exs: Ferrous metals are commonly used in construction and manufacturing industries. 黑色金属常用于建筑和制造业。
The geologist found a ferrous mineral that turned the water reddish-brown. 地质学家发现一种含铁矿物，使水变成红褐色。

defs.cn: 渡船, 渡口；[法] 摆渡营业权, 轮渡

words.root: 联想：渡船来回运送乘客过海
exs: The ferry crosses the harbor every twenty minutes during the summer season. 夏季期间，渡轮每二十分钟横渡一次港口。
Waiting at the ferry terminal, tourists watched boats unload cars and passengers. 游客在渡轮码头等候时，观看船只卸下汽车和乘客。

defs.cn: 纤维, 构造, 纤维制品；[化] 纤维

words.root: 源自拉丁 fibra（纤维）→ 纤维
exs: This fiber absorbs sweat quickly during long-distance running sessions. 这种纤维在长跑训练中快速吸汗。
Eating foods rich in fiber helps prevent digestive problems among elderly residents. 吃富含纤维的食物有助于防止老年居民消化问题。

defs.cn: 斗士, 战士, 好战者, 战斗机

words.root: fight（战斗）+ -er（人/物）→ 战斗者/战斗机。
exs: The brave fighter refused to surrender despite the overwhelming enemy force. 勇敢的战士尽管面对压倒性敌军仍拒绝投降。
The fighter pilot, trained for years, flew the jet through storm clouds. 训练多年的战斗机飞行员驾驶喷气机穿过乌云。

defs.cn: 细丝, 细线, 灯丝, 单纤维；[化] 长丝; 单丝(复丝中的单根细丝); 丝极

words.root: fil（线）→ filament 细丝/灯丝
exs: The filament glowed brightly inside the antique glass bulb. 灯丝在古董玻璃灯泡内明亮发光。
When the filament heats up, it emits a warm yellow light. 灯丝受热时，会发出温暖的黄光。

defs.cn: 污秽, 不洁, 猥亵；[法] 污秽, 污物, 淫猥

words.root: 与 foul（肮脏）同源 → 污秽
exs: The abandoned factory was covered with filth and broken glass. 废弃工厂覆盖着污秽和碎玻璃。
After cleaning the filthy kitchen, he removed layers of grease and filth. 清理肮脏厨房后，他刮掉了层层油污和污秽。

defs.cn: 雅致地, 仔细地, 敏锐地, 微细地

words.root: fine（精细）+ -ly（副词）→ 精细地。
exs: The chef finely chopped the garlic for the sauce. 厨师为酱汁把大蒜切得很细。
The watchmaker worked with finely calibrated tools that could measure tiny errors. 钟表匠使用经过精细校准的工具，能测量微小误差。

defs.cn: 有限的, 有穷的, 限定的

words.root: fin（边界）+ -ite → 有限的
exs: Finite resources force governments to prioritize clean energy and public transport. 有限的资源迫使政府优先发展清洁能源和公共交通。
Scientists know that Earth's freshwater supply is finite and fragile. 科学家知道地球的淡水供应有限且脆弱。

words.root: fire（火）+ place（处）→ 壁炉
exs: A warm fire crackled in the stone fireplace during winter nights. 冬夜，石头壁炉里温暖火焰噼啪作响。
Sitting beside the fireplace, the family shared stories under soft light. 坐在壁炉旁，一家人在柔和灯光下分享故事。

defs.cn: 烟火具, 烟火, 烟火信号弹, 焰火, 激情的表现

words.root: fire（火）+ work（作品）→ 火工品→烟火。
exs: A single firework exploded above the river at midnight. 午夜时分，一支烟火在河面上空爆炸。
The children watched the firework that rose slowly before bursting into gold sparks. 孩子们观看那支缓缓升起的烟火，随后炸成金色火花。

defs.cn: 坚固, 坚牢, 坚定

words.root: firm（坚固）+ -ness（状态）→ 坚固/坚定
exs: The firmness of the wooden table impressed the furniture inspectors. 木桌的坚固给家具检查员留下深刻印象。
Despite public pressure, the minister showed firmness in rejecting the proposal. 尽管有公众压力，部长仍坚决拒绝该提案。

defs.cn: 裂开, 分裂, 分体；[化] 裂变

words.root: fiss（裂）+ -ion → 分裂
exs: Nuclear fission releases enormous energy inside a reactor core. 核裂变在反应堆堆芯内释放巨大能量。
Scientists studied how fission splits atoms to generate stable electricity. 科学家研究裂变如何分裂原子以产生稳定电力。

defs.cn: 适合, 合宜, 合理, 恰当, 健康；[医] 适合性, 适应性

words.root: fit（适合）+ -ness（状态）→ 适合性/健康状态。
exs: Regular exercise improves physical fitness and reduces the risk of chronic disease. 规律锻炼能改善身体健康，降低慢性病风险。
To improve fitness, many office workers take brisk walks during lunch breaks. 为提高体能，许多上班族在午休时快走。

defs.cn: 试穿, 试衣, 装配, 装置

words.root: fit（适合）+ -ing → 试穿、装配。
exs: The tailor checked the fitting of the jacket before the wedding. 裁缝在婚礼前检查了夹克的试穿效果。
The engineer inspected the fitting, noting that the valve leaked under high pressure. 工程师检查了装置，注意到阀门在高压下泄漏。

defs.cn: 固定(状态), 固定物, 设备；[计] 夹具

words.root: fix（固定）+ -ture（名词）→固定物
exs: The metal fixture holds the shelf securely to the wall. 金属固定件把架子牢牢固定在墙上。
Mounted on the ceiling, the lighting fixture provides soft illumination for the study. 安装在天花板上，灯具为书房提供柔和照明。

defs.cn: 小薄片, 扁薄的一层, 火星, 晒鱼架子

words.root: flake：像“飞落”的小片，片状剥落。
exs: A thin flake of paint peeled off the old wooden door. 一片薄漆从旧木门上剥落。
The fisherman laid the cod on a flake, letting the sea breeze dry them. 渔民把鳕鱼放在晒鱼架上，让海风把它们吹干。

defs.cn: 侧面, 侧腹, 胁, 腰窝肉

words.root: flank谐音“法兰克”：战士守住侧翼。
exs: The soldiers attacked the enemy's flank at dawn. 士兵们在黎明攻击了敌人的侧翼。
The river flanks the eastern side of the town, providing a natural barrier. 河流位于城镇东侧，形成天然屏障。

defs.cn: 法兰绒, 法兰绒衣服

words.root: 音译“法兰绒”→柔软布
exs: Grandpa wore a soft flannel shirt during gardening. 爷爷在园艺时穿着柔软的法兰绒衬衫。
The flannel blanket, folded neatly, kept the baby warm through the night. 整齐折叠的法兰绒毯子让婴儿整夜保暖。

defs.cn: 飘, 摆动, 拍打, 拍打声, 片状垂悬物
拍打, 鼓翼而飞, 飘动

words.root: flap：拟声“啪”，片状物上下拍打。
exs: The loose flap of the tent kept flapping in the strong wind. 帐篷上松垂的布片在大风中不断拍打。
Seeing the invitation, she sealed the envelope flap before posting it. 看到邀请函后，她在寄出前封好信封盖。

defs.cn: 细颈瓶, 烧瓶, 小水瓶；[化] 瓶; 烧瓶

words.root: flask谐音“弗拉斯克”：细颈小瓶。
exs: The chemist placed the flask on the hot plate. 化学家把烧瓶放在加热板上。
The hiker filled his flask with water before climbing the steep trail. 徒步者在攀登陡峭山路前把小水瓶装满水。

defs.cn: 弄平, 打倒, 使失去光泽

words.root: flat（平）+ -en（使）→压平
exs: Heavy rain can flatten the tall grass in the field. 大雨会压平田里的高草。
The boxer's powerful punch flattened his opponent before the referee intervened. 在裁判介入前，拳击手的重拳击倒了对手。

defs.cn: 奉承, 阿谀, 使高兴；[机] 平面锤

words.root: flatter：像“抚他”，抚平对方即奉承。
exs: He tried to flatter the judge with exaggerated praise, but failed. 他试图用夸张的赞美奉承法官，但失败了。
The dress flattered her figure, which boosted her confidence before the interview. 这条裙子衬托出她的身材，使她在面试前更有信心。

defs.cn: 缺点, 裂纹, 瑕疵, 一阵狂风；[化] 划痕; 裂缝; 裂纹

words.root: flaw：玻璃上“浮拉”一道裂纹。
exs: A tiny flaw made the diamond less valuable. 一个小瑕疵使钻石价值降低。
The inspector found a flaw that could weaken the bridge's structure. 检查员发现了一个可能削弱桥梁结构的裂缝。

defs.cn: 投掷, 急冲, 嘲弄
投, 丢下, 抛弃, 使陷入, 挥动, 嘲笑, 扫视

words.root: 谐音“飞扔”→猛掷
exs: The child would fling toys across the room. 孩子会把玩具扔过房间。
Flinging open the door, she rushed out without saying goodbye. 她猛地推开门，没道别就冲了出去。

defs.cn: 变动, 起伏, 动摇

words.root: fluctuate：fluct=波浪→起伏波动。
exs: Stock prices fluctuated wildly throughout the volatile trading day. 股价在动荡的交易日内剧烈波动。
The manager fluctuated between hiring and cutting staff, causing uncertainty among employees. 经理在招人还是裁员之间摇摆，导致员工们感到不确定。

defs.cn: 变动, 波动, 动摇；[化] 涨落; 起伏; 波动; 脉动

words.root: fluctu（波浪）+ -ation → 波动。
exs: The stock market showed rapid fluctuation in prices yesterday. 股市昨日价格出现快速波动。
The report analyzed fluctuation in demand as customers changed their habits. 报告分析了需求波动，因为顾客改变了习惯。

words.root: fluor（氟石）+ -escent（发…的）→荧光
exs: The fluorescent tubes light the laboratory efficiently all night. 荧光灯管整夜高效地照亮实验室。
Fluorescent materials, exposed to ultraviolet light, emit a bright green glow. 荧光材料在紫外线照射下会发出明亮的绿光。

defs.cn: 摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰
摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰
拍(翅), 使焦急；[计] 颤动

words.root: flutter：像“扑拉”，翅膀轻快颤动。
exs: A white butterfly fluttered above the garden roses. 一只白蝴蝶在花园玫瑰上方扑翅飞舞。
Her eyelashes fluttered nervously while she waited for the exam results. 等待考试成绩时，她的睫毛紧张地颤动。

defs.cn: 流出, 涨潮, 变迁

words.root: flu（流）+ x → 流出、涨潮。
exs: The flux helped the two metal pieces join smoothly. 助焊剂帮助两块金属平滑连接。
The river's flux increased after heavy rain, flooding the low fields. 大雨后河水流量增加，淹没了低洼田地。

defs.cn: 泡沫, 水沫, 泡沫材料

words.root: 谐音“浮沫”→泡沫
exs: Warm water and soap produce thick foam quickly. 温水和肥皂会迅速产生浓密泡沫。
The surfers waited, watching the foam collapse against the rocks. 冲浪者等待着，看着泡沫撞向岩石后破灭。

defs.cn: 贴箔于, 衬托, 阻止, 挡开, 挫败

words.root: foil：foli（叶）→薄如叶的金属箔。
exs: The police foiled the robbery at the bank. 警方挫败了银行抢劫案。
A thin foil of gold covered the frame, giving the portrait a warm glow. 一层薄薄的金箔覆盖相框，使肖像泛起温暖的光泽。

defs.cn: 从者, 属下, 追补者；[电] 随动机

words.root: follow（跟随）+ -er（人）→ 跟随者。
exs: The young follower carried her mentor's heavy books through the crowded campus every morning. 这位年轻的随从每天早晨都替导师搬运沉重的书本穿过拥挤的校园。
Waiting patiently outside the studio, the devoted follower hoped to catch a glimpse of the famous singer. 在录音室外耐心等候，这位忠实的追随者希望能瞥见那位著名歌手。

defs.cn: 步道, 人行道, 小路

words.root: foot（脚）+ path（路）→ 脚踩出的小路。
exs: A narrow footpath winds between the old houses after heavy rain. 一条狭窄的小路在大雨后蜿蜒穿过老屋之间。
We followed the footpath that led to a hidden waterfall. 我们沿着通往隐秘瀑布的小路前行。

words.root: fore-（前，同 before）→ 在前/船头
exs: The fore part of the ancient ship remains remarkably intact. 这艘古船的前部保存得异常完好。
Standing near the fore part, the guide pointed out where sailors once stored ropes. 站在船头附近，导游指出水手们曾存放绳索的地方。

words.root: fore-（前）+ see（看见）→ 提前看见 → 预见。
exs: Economists foresee a gradual recovery despite rising unemployment. 尽管失业率上升，经济学家仍预见经济将逐步复苏。
Foreseeing the danger, the pilot rerouted the flight around the storm. 预见到危险，飞行员将航班改道绕开风暴。

defs.cn: 打制, 锻造, 伪造

words.root: 炉火中打制金属；引申为打造、伪造。
exs: The blacksmith forged a strong iron gate in the hot workshop. 铁匠在炽热的作坊里锻造出一扇坚固的铁门。
She was accused of forging documents to obtain a visa. 她因涉嫌伪造文件获取签证而被指控。

words.root: former（从前的）+ -ly 副词后缀 → 从前
exs: The building formerly housed a busy post office. 这栋楼以前曾是一家繁忙的邮局。
The district, which was formerly a quiet village, now attracts many young professionals. 这个地区以前是安静村庄，如今吸引许多年轻专业人士。

defs.cn: 巨大的, 优秀的, 可怕的, 艰难的

words.root: 联想：强敌“形”势逼人，令人畏惧。
exs: The team faced a formidable opponent in the national robotics competition. 该团队在全国机器人竞赛中面对了一个强大的对手。
Although the mountain path was formidable, the experienced climbers reached the summit before dusk. 尽管山路艰难，有经验的登山者仍在天黑前到达山顶。

defs.cn: 用公式表示, 明确叙述, 制订；[机] 公式化, 公式表示

words.root: formula（公式）+ -ate（使）→ 公式化、制订。
exs: The committee formulated a new policy to reduce campus waste. 委员会制订了新政策以减少校园浪费。
Experts believe that the plan was carefully formulated before testing. 专家认为该计划在测试前经过了周密制订。

defs.cn: 系统陈述, 公式化, 配制；[化] 表述; 数学表述; 数式化; 数学表述

words.root: form（形成）+ -ulation → 表述/配方
exs: The formulation of the policy took three months. 这项政策的制定花了三个月。
Having refined the formulation, researchers tested it on volunteers. 完善配方后，研究人员在志愿者身上进行了测试。

defs.cn: 放弃, 断念, 抛弃；[法] 遗弃, 抛弃, 摒绝

words.root: for-（离开）+ sake（旧事）→ 离开旧事 → 放弃。
exs: The retired soldier refused to forsake his old comrades during the crisis. 这位退役军人在危机中拒绝抛弃他的老战友。
Forsaking the noisy city, the couple moved to a quiet village to grow vegetables. 夫妇俩舍弃喧闹的城市，搬到一个安静的村庄种菜。

defs.cn: 堡垒, 要塞, 易货站

words.root: fort（强）→ 坚固防御工事。
exs: The old fort guarded the river mouth for centuries. 这座古老要塞守护河口数个世纪。
Soldiers built a fort overlooking the valley to control trade. 士兵们建了一座俯瞰山谷的要塞以控制贸易。

words.root: forth（向前）+ coming（来）→ 即将到来
exs: The forthcoming report will influence next year's budget. 即将发布的报告将影响明年预算。
The forthcoming summit, which many experts attend, will shape trade rules. 许多专家将参加的即将举行的峰会将影响贸易规则。

defs.cn: 筑要塞, 以要塞防守

words.root: fort（强/堡垒）+ 名词后缀 → 坚固要塞。
exs: The medieval fortress protected the valley from frequent enemy raids. 这座中世纪要塞保护山谷免受频繁敌军袭击。
Built on a rocky hill, the fortress overlooked the trade route for centuries. 建在岩石山丘上，这座要塞几个世纪俯瞰着贸易路线。

defs.cn: 论坛, 公开讨论的广场, 法庭, 讨论会；[法] 讨论会, 专题讨论, 公共论坛

words.root: 拉丁 forum（广场）→ 公开讨论场所。
exs: The online forum helps students share study resources easily. 这个在线论坛帮助学生轻松分享学习资源。
The professor spoke at a forum that discussed climate change. 教授在一个讨论气候变化的论坛上发言。

defs.cn: 化石的, 陈腐的, 守旧的

words.root: foss-（挖）+ -il → 挖出的化石
exs: The museum displayed a fossil from the Jurassic period. 博物馆展出一件侏罗纪时期的化石。
Buried for millions of years, the fossil revealed ancient marine life. 埋藏数百万年后，这块化石揭示了远古海洋生命。

defs.cn: 污秽的, 邪恶的, 恶臭的, 肮脏的, 恶劣的, 淤塞的
弄脏, 妨害, 污蔑, 犯规, 淤塞
腐烂, 犯规, 缠结
违反规则地, 不正当地

words.root: 联想：foul 像 fowl（家禽）脏臭 → 污秽；犯规。
exs: The referee called a clear foul near the basketball goal. 裁判在篮球篮筐附近判了一次明显犯规。
After the foul smell spread through the kitchen, the guests left early. 恶臭在厨房扩散后，客人们提前离开了。

words.root: 画面：农舍旁扑腾翅膀的飞禽/家禽。
exs: A wild fowl flew over the lake at sunrise. 一只野禽在日出时飞过湖面。
The farmer kept fowls that provided eggs every morning. 农夫饲养家禽，每天早晨提供鸡蛋。

words.root: fract-（打破）+ -ure → 断裂/骨折
exs: The fracture in his wrist healed quickly without surgery. 他手腕的骨折无需手术便很快愈合。
After falling from the ladder, the worker suffered a severe fracture. 从梯子摔下后，这名工人严重骨折。

defs.cn: 易碎的, 脆的；[医] 脆弱的, 脆的

words.root: frag（打碎）+ ile（易…的）→ 易碎的
exs: The antique vase is fragile and needs careful handling. 这只古董花瓶易碎，需要小心处理。
Fragile ecosystems collapse if tourism increases without proper regulation. 脆弱的生态系统如果旅游增长缺乏适当监管就会崩溃。

defs.cn: 芬香的, 馥郁的, 愉快的

words.root: frag-（散发气味）+ -ant（形容词）→ 芳香的
exs: The garden smelled fragrant after the warm spring rain. 温暖的春雨过后，花园闻起来芳香。
Walking past the bakery, I caught a fragrant scent of cinnamon. 经过面包店时，我闻到一股肉桂的香味。

defs.cn: 脆弱的, 虚弱的, 意志薄弱的
少女, 少妇, 灯心草篓

words.root: frag-（断裂）→ 易断→ 脆弱
exs: Her frail hands shook over the cold keyboard. 她虚弱的双手在冰冷的键盘上颤抖。
Although frail, the retired nurse still volunteered at the crowded clinic. 尽管身体虚弱，这位退休护士仍在拥挤的诊所做志愿者。

defs.cn: 欺骗, 欺诈, 诡计, 骗子；[经] 欺诈, 舞弊, 骗子

words.root: 源自拉丁fraus“欺骗”→ 欺诈
exs: The manager committed fraud by inflating sales figures. 经理通过虚增销售额实施欺诈。
Investors lost money because the fraud concealed huge debts. 投资者亏钱，因为骗局隐瞒了巨额债务。

defs.cn: (使)显得新鲜, (使)精神饱满, (使)减少咸味

words.root: fresh（新鲜）+ -en（使）→ 使新鲜
exs: A cool breeze can freshen the room quickly. 凉爽微风能让房间迅速变得清新。
Adding lemon slices helps freshen the drink without sugar. 加柠檬片有助于让饮料清爽而不加糖。

defs.cn: 烦躁, 磨损, 焦急, 网状饰物
烦恼, 不满, 磨损
使烦恼, 腐蚀, 使磨损, 使起波纹

words.root: 谐音‘烦了’→ 烦躁、使烦恼
exs: He frets about every small mistake in the report. 他对报告中的每个小错误都感到烦恼。
She began to fret while waiting for the delayed flight. 她在等待延误航班时开始焦虑不安。

defs.cn: 惊骇, 吃惊；[医] 惊吓

words.root: fright/frighten同源→ 惊吓
exs: The sudden thunder gave the child a terrible fright. 突然的雷声把孩子吓了一大跳。
Hearing a noise downstairs, she felt a sudden fright. 听到楼下的响声，她突然感到一阵惊吓。

defs.cn: 可怕的, 惊人的, 丑的, 非常的

words.root: fright（恐惧）+ -ful（充满）→ 可怕的
exs: The storm produced a frightful noise over the town. 暴风雨在城镇上空发出可怕的声音。
Seeing the frightful scene, the child hid behind his mother. 看到可怕的场景，孩子躲到了母亲身后。

defs.cn: 边缘, 端, 流苏, 穗, 初步

words.root: 流苏挂在边缘→ 边缘、附加
exs: The lampshade has a golden fringe near its edge. 灯罩靠近边缘处有一圈金色流苏。
She trimmed the fringe on the scarf, adding a vintage touch. 她修剪了围巾上的流苏，增添了几分复古气息。

words.root: to and fro=来回→ fro向后/那边
exs: The branches swayed to and fro in the wind. 树枝在风中来回摇摆。
To and fro, the ferry moved across the river as passengers waited. 渡船在河上来回移动，乘客们等待着。

defs.cn: 女礼服, 连衣裙, 工装, 罩袍, 僧衣

words.root: 联想“佛客”穿僧袍→罩袍/连衣裙
exs: She wore a velvet frock to the ceremony. 她穿一件天鹅绒连衣裙参加典礼。
The frock hanging in the window looked elegant under lights. 挂在橱窗里的连衣裙在灯光下显得优雅。

defs.cn: 实践, 履行, 实行, 完成, 结束, 满足；[法] 履行, 完成, 达到

words.root: full（满）+ fill（填满）→ 完成、满足
exs: He fulfilled the contract before the legal deadline. 他在法定期限前履行了合同。
To fulfill her dream, she practiced piano every evening. 为了实现梦想，她每晚练习钢琴。

words.root: fund（资金/债务）+ ing→ 资金/债务转期
exs: The ministry approved funding to refinance the municipal debt. 该部委批准资金用于再融资市政债务。
Funding delays may raise borrowing costs if interest rates increase. 如果利率上升，融资延迟可能会推高借贷成本。

defs.cn: 愤怒, 狂暴, 狂怒的人；[医] 狂乱, 狂暴, 狂怒

words.root: 联想“疯儿”发怒→狂怒
exs: His fury made the tense meeting end abruptly. 他的愤怒让紧张的会议突然结束。
Shouting with fury, the fan protested the unfair decision. 球迷愤怒地大喊，抗议不公平的决定。

words.root: fus-（熔/倒）→ 熔化、融合
exs: The fuse blew during the sudden power surge. 保险丝在突然的电压浪涌中烧断了。
Under extreme heat, metal can fuse, creating a new alloy. 在极高温下，金属会熔化，形成一种新合金。

defs.cn: 大惊小怪, 小题大作, 忙乱
无事自扰, 焦急, 焦燥, 忙乱

words.root: 联想fo=fool, us=我们→ 瞎忙
exs: Don't make a fuss over such a small mistake. 不要为这么小的错误大惊小怪。
The customer complained loudly, making a fuss about the delay. 顾客大声抱怨，因延误而小题大做。

defs.cn: 银河, 星系, 一群(显赫的人物)；[电] 银河系

words.root: gala（奶）+ -cy→银河（乳白色光带）→星系
exs: The distant galaxy contains billions of shining stars. 遥远星系包含数十亿颗发光的恒星。
Astronomers study the galaxy because it reveals cosmic history. 天文学家研究这个星系，因为它揭示宇宙历史。

words.root: 谐音‘敢搏’→ 冒险、赌博
exs: His risky gamble left the startup without cash. 他冒险的赌注让这家初创公司没有了现金。
